abstract: Methods, systems, and devices for wireless communications are described. The network entity may obtain a first message indicating one or more Artificial Intelligence (AI)/Machine Learning (ML) capabilities of a User Equipment (UE), and may also obtain a second message from an AI/ML service indicating one or more AI/ML service capabilities of the AI/ML service. The network entity may output a control message indicating one or more cross-node AI/ML configurations based on one or more AI/ML capabilities of the UE and one or more AI/ML service capabilities of the AI/ML service. One or more cross-node AI/ML configurations may configure AI/ML functionality of a UE for use with AI/ML services. In some examples, a lifecycle management (LCM) procedure may be triggered by the UE, and the UE may send signaling associated with the LCM procedure (e.g., a request for LCM signaling or an indication of LCM). 描述了用于进行无线通信的方法、系统和设备。网络实体可以获得指示用户装备（UE）的一个或多个人工智能（AI）/机器学习（ML）能力的第一消息，并且还可以从AI/ML服务获得指示AI/ML服务的一个或多个AI/ML服务能力的第二消息。网络实体可以基于UE的一个或多个AI/ML能力和AI/ML服务的一个或多个AI/ML服务能力来输出指示一个或多个跨节点AI/ML配置的控制消息。一个或多个跨节点AI/ML配置可以将UE的AI/ML功能配置用于与AI/ML服务一起使用。在一些示例中，生命周期管理（LCM）过程可以由UE触发，并且UE可以发送与LCM过程相关联的信令（例如，对LCM信令的请求或对LCM的指示）。

In one aspect, a terminal device obtains an operating condition of the terminal device. The terminal device then determines a size of a monitoring window over which performance metrics of the artificial intelligence/machine learning model are evaluated based on the operating conditions.

abstract: 全尺寸的学习图像被图像缩小部(11)缩小后输入到FCN(全卷积神经网络)运算部(13)，FCN运算部(13)进行所设定的滤波器系数下的运算并输出缩小标签图像。缩小标签图像被图像放大部(14)放大到全尺寸，误差计算部(15)基于损失函数，来计算该放大后的标签图像与全尺寸的正确图像之间的误差，参数更新部(16)根据该误差来更新滤波器系数。通过学习控制部(17)的控制来重复学习，由此能够制作包含图像放大时产生的误差地执行最佳的分割那样的学习模型。另外，通过在学习模型中包括图像放大处理，能够输出全尺寸的标签图像，也能够高精度地进行模型的精度评价。 The full-size learning image is reduced by an image reduction unit (11), and then input to an FCN (full convolutional neural network) operation unit (13), and the FCN operation unit (13) performs an operation with the set filter coefficients and outputs a reduced label image. The reduced tag image is enlarged to the full size by an image enlarging unit (14), an error calculating unit (15) calculates an error between the enlarged tag image and the full-size correct image based on the loss function, and a parameter updating unit (16) updates the filter coefficient based on the error. By repeating learning under the control of a learning control unit (17), a learning model can be created which includes errors occurring during image magnification and performs optimal segmentation. Further, by including the image enlarging process in the learning model, a full-size label image can be output, and also the accuracy evaluation of the model can be performed with high accuracy.

abstract: The machine learning method performs a data set dividing process of dividing a period into a learning period and a verification period and dividing the data set into learning data and verification data, a candidate learning period dividing process of dividing the candidate learning period into a plurality of divided learning periods, a learning period evaluating process of generating a learning period evaluating model for each divided learning period using learning data corresponding to the divided learning periods and calculating an evaluation index of the learning period evaluating model for each divided learning period using the verification data, a learning period selecting process of repeatedly performing the candidate learning period dividing process and the learning period evaluating process until a prescribed end condition is satisfied, selecting the divided learning period with the evaluation index being high as a learning object period when the end condition is satisfied, and a model outputting process of outputting a learning model in which machine learning is performed using the learning data corresponding to the learning object period. 机器学习方法进行以下处理：数据集分割处理，将期间划分成学习期间和验证期间，并将数据集分割成学习数据和验证数据；候补学习期间划分处理，将候补学习期间划分成多个分割学习期间；学习期间评估处理，使用与分割学习期间相对应的学习数据生成每个分割学习期间的学习期间评估模型，并使用验证数据计算出每个分割学习期间的学习期间评估模型的评估指标；学习期间选定处理，重复进行候补学习期间划分处理及学习期间评估处理直至满足规定的结束条件，在满足结束条件时，将评估指标高的分割学习期间选定为学习对象期间；和模型输出处理，输出使用与学习对象期间相对应的学习数据进行了机器学习的学习模型。

titles.text: Method for converting artificial intelligence into artificial intelligence
人工智能转人工智能的方法

applicants: ZHEJIANG BRAIN THINKING TECH CO LTD
abstract: 本发明公开了一种人工智能转人工智能的方法，该方法通过建立呼入系统，实现客户呼叫接入，同时在呼叫中心建立基本的功能设施，包括但不仅限于IVR自动语音导航、自动呼叫分配、自动报工号、电话排队管理、来电弹屏、通话录音、业务受理、多方电话会议、知识资料库管理和满意度调查。通过以上步骤设置然后经过测试，最终实现人工智能转入人工智能时，不需要经过非智能化操作，很大程度上减少了人工客服的投入，节约成本，同时也能够提高客户进行服务咨询时的信息反馈速度。 The invention discloses a method for converting artificial intelligence into artificial intelligence, which realizes customer call access by establishing a call-in system, and simultaneously establishes basic functional facilities in a call center, including but not limited to IVR automatic voice navigation, automatic call distribution, automatic work number reporting, telephone queuing management, incoming call screen flipping, call recording, service acceptance, multi-party telephone conference, knowledge database management and satisfaction survey. Through the steps, the artificial intelligence is finally switched into the artificial intelligence through testing, non-intelligent operation is not needed, the investment of artificial customer service is reduced to a great extent, the cost is saved, and meanwhile, the information feedback speed of a client in service consultation can be improved.

title: 机器学习装置
abstract: 本发明提供一种机器学习装置，在能够向外部供给电力的车辆中，抑制在灾害时能够从车辆向外部供给的电力量因与机器学习模型的学习相关的处理而减少的情况。机器学习装置设置于能够向外部供给电力的车辆(3)，并具备实施与在车辆中使用的机器学习模型的学习相关的处理的学习部(51)。学习部在取得了灾害信息的情况下，与未取得灾害信息的情况相比，使与学习相关的处理中的电力消耗量降低。 The invention provides a machine learning device, which can restrain the reduction of the electric power amount supplied from a vehicle to the outside during disaster caused by the processing related to the learning of a machine learning model in the vehicle capable of supplying electric power to the outside. The machine learning device is provided in a vehicle (3) capable of supplying electric power to the outside, and is provided with a learning unit (51) that performs processing relating to learning of a machine learning model used in the vehicle. When disaster information is acquired, the learning unit reduces the amount of power consumption in the processing related to learning, as compared to when disaster information is not acquired.
claims: 1. A machine learning device provided in a vehicle capable of supplying electric power to the outside, the machine learning device includes a learning unit that performs processing related to learning of a machine learning model used in the vehicle, the learning unit reduces the amount of power consumption in the process related to the learning when disaster information is acquired, as compared to when the disaster information is not acquired. 2. The machine learning apparatus of claim 1, the machine learning device further includes a position information acquisition unit that acquires position information of the vehicle, when power supply from the vehicle to the outside is predicted based on the disaster information and the location information, the learning unit reduces the amount of power consumption in the process related to the learning, as compared to a case where the power supply is not predicted. 3. The machine learning apparatus of claim 2, the position information acquiring unit acquires a destination of the vehicle, when the supply of electric power from the vehicle to the outside is predicted based on the disaster information and the destination, the learning unit reduces the amount of electric power consumption compared to a case where the supply of electric power is not predicted. 4. The machine learning device of any one of claims 1 to 3, the learning portion reduces the amount of power consumption by stopping processing related to the learning. 5. The machine learning apparatus of claim 4, the machine learning device further includes an output device control unit that controls an output device provided in the vehicle, the output device control portion confirms permission to stop the process related to the learning to a driver of the vehicle via the output device, the learning portion does not stop the process related to the learning when the driver does not allow the stop of the process related to the learning. 6. A machine learning device is provided with: a communication device capable of communicating with a vehicle capable of supplying electric power to the outside; and a control device that performs learning of a machine learning model and transmits the learned machine learning model to the vehicle via the communication device, the control device stops transmission of the learned machine learning model to the vehicle when disaster information is acquired.

title: 机器学习装置
abstract: 提供一种能够预测制造时的三维造型物的变形的机器学习装置。机器学习装置具备：数据获取部，获取第一数据和第二数据，所述第一数据包含表示三维造型物的目标形状的形状数据和表示为了抑制制造中的三维造型物的变形而向三维造型物追加的追加部分的目标形状的追加形状数据，所述第二数据是与三维造型物的变形相关的数据；存储部，存储学习数据集，所述学习数据集包含多个第一数据和多个第二数据；以及学习部，通过执行使用了学习数据集的机器学习，学习第一数据与第二数据的关系。 Provided is a machine learning device capable of predicting the deformation of a three-dimensional shaped object during manufacturing. The machine learning device is provided with: a data acquisition unit that acquires first data including shape data representing a target shape of a three-dimensional shaped object and additional shape data representing a target shape of an additional portion to be added to the three-dimensional shaped object in order to suppress deformation of the three-dimensional shaped object during manufacturing, and second data relating to deformation of the three-dimensional shaped object; a storage unit that stores a learning data set including a plurality of first data and a plurality of second data; and a learning unit that learns the relationship between the first data and the second data by performing machine learning using the learning data set.

title: 机器学习装置
abstract: A machine learning device. Provided is a technique capable of predicting the deformation of a three-dimensional shaped object during production. The machine learning device is provided with: a data acquisition unit that acquires first data including shape data relating to a target shape of a three-dimensional object and molding condition data relating to conditions under which the three-dimensional object is molded by a three-dimensional molding device, and second data relating to deformation of the three-dimensional object; a storage unit that stores a learning data set including a plurality of first data and a plurality of second data; and a learning unit that learns the relationship between the first data and the second data by performing machine learning using the learning data set. 一种机器学习装置。提供一种能够预测在制造时的三维造型物的变形的技术。机器学习装置具备：数据获取部，获取第一数据和第二数据，该第一数据包含与三维造型物的目标形状相关的形状数据以及与由三维造型装置对三维造型物进行造型时的条件相关的造型条件数据，该第二数据与三维造型物的变形相关；存储部，存储包含多个第一数据和多个第二数据的学习数据集；以及学习部，通过执行使用了学习数据集的机器学习，来学习第一数据与第二数据的关系。
claims: 1. A machine learning device is characterized by comprising: a data acquisition unit that acquires first data including shape data relating to a target shape of a three-dimensional object and molding condition data relating to a molding condition when the three-dimensional object is molded by a three-dimensional molding device, and second data relating to deformation of the three-dimensional object; a storage unit that stores a learning data set including a plurality of the first data and a plurality of the second data; and a learning unit that learns a relationship between the first data and the second data by performing machine learning using the learning data set. 2. The machine learning apparatus of claim 1, the molding condition data includes data relating to a density of particles included in a material used for molding the three-dimensional molded object as the molding condition. 3. The machine learning apparatus of claim 1, the first data includes heat treatment condition data relating to conditions of heat treatment for the three-dimensional shaped object. 4. The machine learning apparatus of claim 2, the first data includes heat treatment condition data relating to conditions of heat treatment for the three-dimensional shaped object. 5. The machine learning apparatus of any one of claims 1 to 4, the learning section executes at least one of supervised learning, unsupervised learning, and reinforcement learning as the machine learning. 6. The machine learning apparatus of any one of claims 1 to 4, the data acquiring unit acquires the molding condition data from the plurality of three-dimensional molding machines. 7. The machine learning apparatus of any one of claims 1 to 4, the machine learning device includes a prediction unit that predicts a deformation of a three-dimensional shaped object using a learning model generated by the machine learning performed by the learning unit. 8. The machine learning apparatus of claim 7, the machine learning device includes a correction unit that corrects the modeling condition data based on the prediction result of the prediction unit and outputs the corrected modeling condition data. 9. The machine learning apparatus of claim 8, the correction section corrects the modeling condition data using at least one of a polynomial function and a rational function.

title: 机器学习方法
applicants: HON HAI PREC IND CO LTD
abstract: The machine learning method comprises the following steps: processing the first sensing data by the first detector to generate first object data; generating, by a first detector, a first uncertainty fraction of the first object data; processing the second sensing data by a second detector to generate second object data; generating a second uncertainty fraction of the second object data by a second detector; generating first weight data corresponding to the first object data and second weight data corresponding to the second object data according to the first uncertainty fraction and the second uncertainty fraction through a model; generating prediction data at least according to the first and second weight data; and training the model according to the prediction data. The first and second sensing data correspond to the same environment, and the first and second object data correspond to objects in the environment. Thus, the model performs better. 机器学习方法包括：通过第一侦测器处理第一感测数据，以产生第一物件数据；通过第一侦测器产生第一物件数据的第一不确定性分数；通过第二侦测器处理第二感测数据，以产生第二物件数据；通过第二侦测器产生第二物件数据的第二不确定性分数；通过模型，依据第一及第二不确定性分数产生对应第一物件数据的第一权重数据及对应第二物件数据的第二权重数据；至少依据第一及第二权重数据产生预测数据；以及依据预测数据训练模型。第一及第二感测数据对应相同的环境，且第一及第二物件数据对应环境中的物件。如此一来，模型表现较佳。

title: 机器学习装置
abstract: The invention provides a machine learning device, which can restrain the situation that the amount of power which can be supplied from a vehicle to the outside in disaster is reduced by the processing related to the learning of a machine learning model in the vehicle which can supply power to the outside. The machine learning device is provided in a vehicle (3) capable of supplying electric power to the outside, and is provided with a learning unit (51) that performs processing relating to learning of a machine learning model used in the vehicle. When disaster information is acquired, the learning unit reduces the amount of power consumption in the learning-related process, as compared with the case where disaster information is not acquired. 本发明提供一种机器学习装置，在能够向外部供给电力的车辆中，抑制在灾害时能够从车辆向外部供给的电力量因与机器学习模型的学习相关的处理而减少的情况。机器学习装置设置于能够向外部供给电力的车辆(3)，并具备实施与在车辆中使用的机器学习模型的学习相关的处理的学习部(51)。学习部在取得了灾害信息的情况下，与未取得灾害信息的情况相比，使与学习相关的处理中的电力消耗量降低。
claims: 1. A machine learning device is provided in a vehicle capable of supplying electric power to the outside, wherein, The machine learning device includes a learning unit that performs processing related to learning of a machine learning model used in the vehicle, When disaster information is acquired, the learning unit reduces the amount of power consumption in the process related to learning compared to the case where the disaster information is not acquired, The learning section reduces the amount of power consumption by stopping processing related to the learning, The machine learning device further includes an output device control unit that controls an output device provided in the vehicle, The output device control portion confirms to a driver of the vehicle via the output device permission to stop the learning-related process, The learning unit does not stop the process related to the learning when the driver does not permit stopping the process related to the learning, stops the process related to the learning when the driver does permit stopping the process related to the learning, and restarts the process related to the learning when a predetermined time has elapsed. 2. The machine learning device of claim 1 wherein, The machine learning device further includes a position information acquisition unit that acquires position information of the vehicle, When the supply of electric power from the vehicle to the outside is predicted based on the disaster information and the position information, the learning unit reduces the amount of electric power consumption in the learning-related process, as compared with a case where the supply of electric power is not predicted. 3. The machine learning device of claim 2 wherein, The position information acquisition unit acquires a destination of the vehicle, When the supply of electric power from the vehicle to the outside is predicted based on the disaster information and the destination, the learning unit reduces the electric power consumption amount as compared with a case where the supply of electric power is not predicted.

title: 机器学习装置
abstract: 提供一种能够预测制造时的三维造型物的变形的机器学习装置。机器学习装置具备：数据获取部，获取第一数据和第二数据，所述第一数据包含表示三维造型物的目标形状的形状数据和表示为了抑制制造中的三维造型物的变形而向三维造型物追加的追加部分的目标形状的追加形状数据，所述第二数据是与三维造型物的变形相关的数据；存储部，存储学习数据集，所述学习数据集包含多个第一数据和多个第二数据；以及学习部，通过执行使用了学习数据集的机器学习，学习第一数据与第二数据的关系。 Provided is a machine learning device capable of predicting deformation of a three-dimensional modeling object at the time of manufacturing. The machine learning device is provided with: a data acquisition unit that acquires first data including shape data representing a target shape of a three-dimensional modeling object and additional shape data representing a target shape of an additional portion to be added to the three-dimensional modeling object in order to suppress deformation of the three-dimensional modeling object during manufacturing, and second data relating to deformation of the three-dimensional modeling object; a storage unit that stores a learning data set including a plurality of first data and a plurality of second data; and a learning unit that learns the relationship between the first data and the second data by performing machine learning using the learning data set.
claims: 1. A machine learning device is characterized by comprising: a data acquisition unit that acquires first data including shape data representing a target shape of a three-dimensional modeling object and additional shape data representing a target shape of an additional portion to be added to the three-dimensional modeling object in order to suppress deformation of the three-dimensional modeling object during manufacturing, and second data relating to deformation of the three-dimensional modeling object; a storage unit that stores a learning data set including a plurality of the first data and a plurality of the second data; and A learning unit that learns a relationship between the first data and the second data by performing machine learning using the learning data set, the additional portion is removed after the heat treatment process is performed on the three-dimensional object. 2. The machine learning apparatus of claim 1, wherein the machine learning apparatus, the first data includes material data related to a material of the three-dimensional object. 3. The machine learning apparatus of claim 1, wherein the machine learning apparatus, the first data includes heat treatment condition data related to a condition of heat treatment for the three-dimensional modeling object. 4. The machine learning apparatus of claim 2, wherein, the first data includes heat treatment condition data related to a condition of heat treatment for the three-dimensional modeling object. 5. The machine learning apparatus of any one of claims 1 to 4, the learning section performs at least one of supervised learning, unsupervised learning, and reinforcement learning as the machine learning. 6. The machine learning device according to any one of claims 1 to 4, characterized by comprising: and a prediction unit configured to predict deformation of the three-dimensional modeling object using a learning model generated by the machine learning performed by the learning unit. 7. The machine learning device according to claim 5, comprising: and a prediction unit configured to predict deformation of the three-dimensional modeling object using a learning model generated by the machine learning performed by the learning unit. 8. The machine learning device according to claim 6, comprising: and a correction unit configured to correct the additional shape data based on a prediction result of the prediction unit, and output the corrected additional shape data. 9. The machine learning device according to claim 7, comprising: and a correction unit configured to correct the additional shape data based on a prediction result of the prediction unit, and output the corrected additional shape data.

abstract: The machine learning device according to one embodiment of the present disclosure includes: a road surface detection processing unit that detects a road surface included in the first captured image, based on the first captured image and a first distance image corresponding to the first captured image; a distance value selecting unit that selects one or more distance values to be processed from among a plurality of distance values included in the first distance image, based on a processing result of the road surface detection processing unit; and a learning processing unit that performs machine learning processing based on the first captured image and one or more distance values, thereby generating a learning model in which the second captured image is input and the second distance image corresponding to the second captured image is output. 本公开的一个实施方式的机器学习装置具备：路面检测处理部，其基于第一拍摄图像以及与第一拍摄图像对应的第一距离图像，检测第一拍摄图像中所包含的路面；距离值选择部，其基于路面检测处理部的处理结果，选择第一距离图像中所包含的多个距离值中的、成为处理对象的一个以上的距离值；以及学习处理部，其基于第一拍摄图像和一个以上的距离值进行机器学习处理，由此生成被输入第二拍摄图像并输出与第二拍摄图像对应的第二距离图像的学习模型。
claims: 1. The machine learning apparatus of any one of claim 1 to claim 3, the machine learning device further includes a solid object detection processing unit that detects a solid object located above the road surface included in the first captured image, the distance value selecting unit selects, as the one or more distance values, a distance value used in the detection process of the three-dimensional object detection processing unit, among a plurality of distance values included in the first distance image. 5. abstract: 提供一种能够高效地进行机器学习的机器学习装置。机器学习装置具备：视觉执行部，其通过从机器人程序执行视觉执行命令，利用视觉传感器拍摄对象物(W)，并从拍摄到的拍摄图像检测或判定对象物(W)；结果取得部，其通过从机器人程序执行结果取得命令来取得对象物(W)的检测结果或判定结果；追加注释部，其通过从机器人程序执行注释命令，基于对象物(W)的图像的检测结果或判定结果，对拍摄图像赋予标签，取得新的学习数据；以及学习部，其通过从机器人程序执行学习命令，使用新的学习数据进行机器学习。 Provided is a machine learning device capable of efficiently performing machine learning. The machine learning device is provided with: a vision execution unit that images the object (W) with the vision sensor by executing a vision execution command from the robot program, and detects or determines the object (W) from the captured image; a result acquisition unit that acquires the detection result or determination result of the object (W) by acquiring a command from the robot program execution result; an additional annotation unit that tags the captured image based on the detection result or determination result of the image of the object (W) by executing an annotation command from the robot program, and acquires new learning data; and a learning unit that performs machine learning by executing a learning command from the robot program using the new learning data.

The machine learning apparatus of claim 1, the annotation command assigns the tag to the detection result when the score of the detection result of the object is smaller than a predetermined threshold. 5. The machine learning apparatus of any one of claims 1 to 4, the machine learning device further includes: a teaching unit that teaches a model pattern representing a feature of an image of the object; an object detection unit that detects an image of the object from 1 or more input images including the object, using the model pattern; a labeling unit configured to label a detection result of the object based on the detection result; and and an image processing unit that associates an image based on the input image with the tag, and uses the image based on the input image and the tag as learning data. 6. A machine learning system comprising a plurality of machine learning apparatuses according to any one of claims 1 to 4, the machine learning unit provided in each of the plurality of machine learning devices shares a learning model, and the machine learning unit provided in each of the plurality of machine learning devices learns the shared learning model. 7. A machine learning device for a robot using a vision sensor, the machine learning device includes: a program setting unit that sets at least 1 of a visual execution command, a result acquisition command, a comment command, and a learning command in a robot program for the robot; a vision execution unit that images an object using the vision sensor by executing the robot program, and detects or determines the object from the captured image; a result acquisition unit that acquires a detection result or a determination result of the object by executing the robot program; an additional annotation unit that acquires new learning data by labeling the captured image based on a detection result or a determination result of the image of the object by executing the robot program; and and a learning unit that performs machine learning by executing the robot program using the new learning data.

abstract: The machine learning method includes processing a first global image and a first local image through a first expansion pipeline to generate a first expanded global image and a first expanded local image, processing the first global image through a second expansion pipeline to generate a second expanded global image, processing the first expanded global image through a first encoder to generate a first global characterization vector, processing the second expanded global image and the first expanded local image through a second encoder to generate a second global characterization vector and a first local characterization vector, comparing the first global characterization vector and the second global characterization vector to generate a global loss function, comparing the first global characterization vector and the first local characterization vector to generate a hybrid loss function, and adjusting the second encoder according to the global loss function and the hybrid loss function. Thus, the training result is better. 机器学习方法包括：通过第一扩充管道对第一全域影像及第一局部影像进行处理以产生第一扩充全域影像及第一扩充局部影像；通过第二扩充管道对第一全域影像进行处理以产生第二扩充全域影像；通过第一编码器对第一扩充全域影像进行处理以产生第一全域表征向量；通过第二编码器对第二扩充全域影像及第一扩充局部影像进行处理以产生第二全域表征向量及第一局部表征向量；比较第一及第二全域表征向量以产生全域损失函数；比较第一全域表征向量及第一局部表征向量以产生混和损失函数；以及依据全域损失函数及混和损失函数调整第二编码器。如此一来，训练结果较佳。

title: 机器学习装置
abstract: A machine learning device (100) learns control parameters for controlling machining conditions in an electric discharge machine (1). A machine learning device (100) is provided with: a state observation unit (30) for observing a plurality of state variables representing the machining state during electric discharge machining; and a learning unit (40) that learns the control parameter based on the plurality of state variables. 机器学习装置(100)对控制放电加工机(1)中的加工条件的控制参数进行学习。机器学习装置(100)具有：状态观测部(30)，其对表示放电加工中的加工状态的多个状态变量进行观测；以及学习部(40)，其基于多个状态变量而学习控制参数。

abstract: When a vehicle component is replaced, the estimation accuracy of a machine learning model used in the vehicle is lowered. The machine learning device is provided with: a learning unit (31) that performs learning of a machine learning model used in the vehicle (1); and a detection unit (32) that detects replacement of a vehicle component mounted on the vehicle. When a vehicle component related to input data of a machine learning model is replaced, a learning unit performs relearning of the machine learning model using a training data set corresponding to the replaced vehicle component. 在车辆部件被进行了更换的情况下，在车辆中使用的机器学习模型的推定精度会降低。机器学习装置具备：学习部(31)，其进行在车辆(1)中使用的机器学习模型的学习；和检测部(32)，其对搭载于车辆的车辆部件的更换进行检测。学习部在与机器学习模型的输入数据有关的车辆部件被进行了更换的情况下，使用与更换后的车辆部件对应的训练数据集，进行机器学习模型的再学习。
claims: 1. A machine learning device is provided with: a learning unit that learns a machine learning model used in a vehicle; and A detection unit that detects replacement of a vehicle component mounted on the vehicle by reading identification information of the vehicle component, The learning unit performs relearning of the machine learning model using a training data set corresponding to the replaced vehicle component, based on the detection of the replacement of the vehicle component by the detection unit in relation to the input data of the machine learning model, The machine learning model is a neural network model, the learning unit performs relearning of the machine learning model by updating parameters of the machine learning model set before relearning, values of output data output from the machine learning model are used for control of the vehicle, The vehicle component is an actuator required for traveling of the vehicle, the machine learning device is an electronic control unit provided in the vehicle, the machine learning device controls the actuator, and a command value from the machine learning device to the actuator is used as input data of the machine learning model, When it is determined by the detection unit that the vehicle component is replaced, the learning unit creates a training data set corresponding to the replaced vehicle component, uses the machine learning device to set a command value of the replaced vehicle component as an actual measurement value of the input data in the training data set corresponding to the replaced vehicle component, sets a sensor for acquiring an actual measurement value of output data of the machine learning model in the vehicle, combines the input data and the corresponding actual measurement value of the output data to create the training data set, When creating the training data set, the learning unit determines whether or not the number of training data sets is equal to or greater than a predetermined value, the predetermined value being predetermined and set to a number required to obtain the estimation accuracy of the required neural network model, When it is determined that the number of training data sets is equal to or greater than the predetermined value, the learning unit repeatedly updates the parameters of the machine learning model by an error back propagation method using the training data sets corresponding to the replaced vehicle components, generates a re-learned machine learning model so that a difference between a value of output data outputted from the machine learning model and an actual measurement value of the output data becomes smaller, The learning unit performs relearning of the machine learning model using a training data set corresponding to a vehicle component after replacement only when the vehicle component related to the input data of the machine learning model is replaced with a vehicle component of a different configuration. 2. The machine learning apparatus of claim 1, An updating unit for updating the machine learning model, The learning unit is provided in a server and transmits the relearned machine learning model to the vehicle, and the updating unit applies the relearned machine learning model to the vehicle. 3. The machine learning apparatus of claim 1 or 2, The learning unit is provided in the vehicle and applies the relearned machine learning model to the vehicle.

abstract: 本发明提高学习模型的反馈效率。实施方式的机器学习装置具备：推断部，基于学习模型，针对学习用的数据所包含的要素，按照对要素进行分类的多个类别中的每个类别，推断表示被分类到该类别的可能性的似然；损失值计算部，基于规定的损失函数和由推断部推断出的每个类别的似然，计算表示似然的错误的程度的损失值；权重计算部，基于按照每个类别计算出的似然中的、应将要素分类为真的第一类别的第一似然与不应将要素分类为真的其它类别的第二似然的比较结果来计算权重；以及机器学习部，基于损失值和权重，使学习模型机器学习。 The invention improves the feedback efficiency of the learning model. The machine learning device of the embodiment includes: an estimation unit configured to estimate, for each of a plurality of categories into which an element is classified, a likelihood indicating a possibility of being classified into the category, for the element included in the data for learning, based on the learning model; a loss value calculation unit that calculates a loss value indicating a degree of error of the likelihood based on a predetermined loss function and the likelihood for each category estimated by the estimation unit; a weight calculation unit that calculates a weight based on a result of comparison between a first likelihood that an element should be classified into a first class and a second likelihood that the element should not be classified into another class, among the likelihoods calculated for each class; and a machine learning unit that machine-learns the learning model based on the loss value and the weight.
claims: 1. The machine learning apparatus of claim 1, the weight calculation unit calculates a weight based on a result of comparison between the first likelihood and the second likelihood that is the highest of the other types of likelihoods. 3. The machine learning apparatus of claim 1 or 2, the weight calculation unit further calculates the weight based on a difference between the first likelihood and the second likelihood. 4. abstract: 机器学习装置包含：处理器，其处理数据样本；以及存储装置，其储存处理的结果。处理器根据多个学习数据库制作多个识别器。多个学习数据库分别储存多个学习数据样本。处理器制作多个识别器各自的识别性能的评价结果，根据评价结果，将多个学习数据库中的一个学习数据库以及根据所述一个学习数据库生成的识别器决定为要使用的学习数据库以及识别器。 The machine learning device includes: a processor that processes data samples; and a storage device that stores a result of the processing. The processor creates a plurality of recognizers from the plurality of learning databases. The plurality of learning databases respectively store a plurality of learning data samples. The processor generates an evaluation result of the recognition performance of each of the plurality of recognizers, and determines one of the plurality of learning databases and the recognizer generated from the one learning database as the learning database and the recognizer to be used, based on the evaluation result.

title: 机器学习装置
abstract: 本公开涉及机器学习装置。机器学习车辆(2)特有的学习模型的机器学习装置具备：使用包含由设置于车辆的检测器检测出的状态参数的值的训练数据集进行学习模型的机器学习的学习部(146、333)；以及在由检测器检测出的状态参数的值发生了异常的情况下取得由其他车辆检测出的状态参数的值的参数值取得部(145、332)。学习部在由检测器检测出的状态参数的值发生了异常的情况下，使用代替由检测器检测出的状态参数的值而包含由参数值取得部从其他车辆取得的值的训练数据集，进行学习模型的机器学习。由此，即使构成训练数据集的状态参数的值发生了异常，也能适当地学习学习模型。 The present disclosure relates to machine learning devices. A machine learning device for machine learning a learning model specific to a vehicle (2) is provided with: a learning unit (146, 333) that performs machine learning of a learning model using a training data set including values of state parameters detected by a detector provided in the vehicle; and a parameter value acquisition unit (145, 332) that acquires the value of the state parameter detected by the other vehicle when the value of the state parameter detected by the detector is abnormal. When the value of the state parameter detected by the detector is abnormal, the learning unit performs machine learning of the learning model using a training data set including values acquired from another vehicle by the parameter value acquisition unit instead of the value of the state parameter detected by the detector. Thus, even if an abnormality occurs in the values of the state parameters constituting the training data set, the learning model can be appropriately learned.
claims: 1. abstract: A machine learning system for processing data corresponding to an incoming transaction. The machine learning system includes a classification history module including a memory configured to store status data for a plurality of categories indexed by respective category identifiers, wherein the status data stored in the memory for each category identifier corresponds to previous transactions associated with the entity and the respective category. The decay logic is configured to modify the state data stored in the memory based on a time difference between a time of an incoming transaction and a time of a previous transaction. When the memory contains state data for an entity and category identifier pair associated with an incoming transaction, a time-difference dependent decay function is applied to the stored state data to generate a decay version. The state data output from the decay logic stage is updated using an input tensor generated from data corresponding to the incoming transaction to generate updated state data. 用于处理与到来的交易对应的数据的机器学习系统。机器学习系统包括分类历史模块，分类历史模块包括：存储器，其被配置成存储由相应的类别标识符索引的多个类别的状态数据，其中在存储器中针对每个类别标识符存储的状态数据对应于与实体和相应的类别相关联的先前交易。衰减逻辑级被配置成基于到来的交易的时间与先前交易的时间之间的时间差来修改存储在存储器中的状态数据。当存储器包含与到来的交易相关联的实体和类别标识符对的状态数据时，将依赖于时间差的衰减函数应用于所存储的状态数据以生成衰减版本。使用根据与到来的交易对应的数据生成的输入张量来更新从衰减逻辑级输出的状态数据，以生成更新的状态数据。

title: 微型机器学习
abstract: Techniques are described for generating and applying micro machine learning variants of machine learning algorithms to conserve computing resources when adapting and selecting machine learning algorithms. In an embodiment, at least one of the super parameter values for the reference variant is modified to a new super parameter value, thereby generating a new variant of the machine learning algorithm from the reference variant of the machine learning algorithm. Based on the cost metric of the new variant of the machine learning algorithm and comparing the performance scores of the new variant and the reference variant, the system determines whether the modified reference machine algorithm is a micro-machine learning algorithm that is computationally less costly than the reference variant of the machine learning algorithm but closely follows the accuracy of the reference variant. 描述了用于生成和应用机器学习算法的微型机器学习变体以在调整和选择机器学习算法时节省计算资源的技术。在实施例中，用于参考变体的超参数值中的至少一个超参数值被修改为新的超参数值，从而从机器学习算法的参考变体生成机器学习算法的新变体。基于机器学习算法的新变体的成本度量并将新变体和参考变体的性能得分进行比较，系统确定修改后的参考机器算法是否是计算上成本低于机器学习算法的参考变体但紧密跟随参考变体的准确度的微型机器学习算法。

abstract: 本发明提供一种能够在车辆中高效地进行神经网络模型的学习的机器学习装置。设于车辆的机器学习装置具备：学习计划部(81)，其制作神经网络模型的学习计划；数据集制作部(82)，其取得多个输入参数的实测值和至少一个输出参数的实测值来制作训练数据集；学习部(83)，其在车辆停着时进行神经网络模型的学习；以及停车期间预测部(84)，其预测车辆的停车期间。数据集制作部将训练数据集分到基于多个输入参数的各个范围确定的多个学习区域。学习部按各学习区域进行神经网络模型的学习。学习计划部将多个学习区域分配到停车期间以使得在停车期间中神经网络模型的学习不中断。 The invention provides a machine learning device capable of efficiently learning a neural network model in a vehicle. A machine learning device provided in a vehicle is provided with: a learning planning unit (81) for creating a learning plan of the neural network model; a data set creation unit (82) that creates a training data set by acquiring measured values of a plurality of input parameters and measured values of at least one output parameter; a learning unit (83) that learns a neural network model when the vehicle is stopped; and a parking period prediction unit (84) that predicts the parking period of the vehicle. The data set creating unit divides the training data set into a plurality of learning regions determined based on respective ranges of the plurality of input parameters. The learning unit learns the neural network model for each learning region. The learning planning section assigns a plurality of learning regions to the parking period so that learning of the neural network model is not interrupted during the parking period.

title: 机器学习装置
abstract: The invention provides a machine learning device capable of efficiently learning a neural network model in a vehicle. The machine learning device provided in a vehicle is provided with: a learning planning unit (81) that creates a learning plan for the neural network model; a data set creation unit (82) that obtains actual measurement values of a plurality of input parameters and actual measurement values of at least one output parameter, and creates a training data set; a learning unit (83) that performs learning of the neural network model when the vehicle is stationary; and a parking period prediction unit (84) that predicts a parking period of the vehicle. The data set creating unit divides the training data set into a plurality of learning regions defined based on the respective ranges of the plurality of input parameters. The learning unit learns the neural network model for each learning region. The learning planning unit allocates a plurality of learning regions to the parking period so that learning of the neural network model is not interrupted during the parking period. 本发明提供一种能够在车辆中高效地进行神经网络模型的学习的机器学习装置。设于车辆的机器学习装置具备：学习计划部(81)，其制作神经网络模型的学习计划；数据集制作部(82)，其取得多个输入参数的实测值和至少一个输出参数的实测值来制作训练数据集；学习部(83)，其在车辆停着时进行神经网络模型的学习；以及停车期间预测部(84)，其预测车辆的停车期间。数据集制作部将训练数据集分到基于多个输入参数的各个范围确定的多个学习区域。学习部按各学习区域进行神经网络模型的学习。学习计划部将多个学习区域分配到停车期间以使得在停车期间中神经网络模型的学习不中断。
claims: 1. A machine learning device provided in a vehicle, the machine learning device comprising: a learning plan unit that creates a learning plan of a neural network model that outputs at least one output parameter from a plurality of input parameters; a data set creating unit that creates a training data set by acquiring actual measurement values of the plurality of input parameters and actual measurement values of the at least one output parameter corresponding to the actual measurement values; a learning unit that performs learning of the neural network model using the training data set when the vehicle is stationary, based on the learning plan; and a parking period prediction unit that predicts a parking period of the vehicle, the data set creating section divides the training data set into a plurality of learning regions determined based on respective ranges of the plurality of input parameters, the learning unit learns the neural network model for each learning region, the learning planning section allocates the plurality of learning regions to the parking period so that learning of the neural network model is not interrupted during the parking period. 2. The machine learning apparatus of claim 1, the plurality of learning regions include a small learning region and a large learning region including the small learning region, the frequency of occurrence of a range of input parameters for defining the small learning region is higher than the frequency of occurrence of a range of input parameters for defining the large learning region, The learning planning section selectively assigns the small learning region and the large learning region to the parking period. 3. The machine learning apparatus of claim 1, and giving learning priority to the plurality of learning areas. 4. The machine learning apparatus of claim 3, the learning planning unit sets a higher priority for learning a learning region including a value of the input parameter having a relatively high frequency of occurrence than for learning a learning region including a value of the input parameter having a relatively low frequency of occurrence. 5. The machine learning apparatus of claim 3, the learning planning unit changes the priority of the learning according to information on a road on which the vehicle is traveling or a warm-up state of an internal combustion engine provided in the vehicle.

title: 机器学习系统
abstract: 本发明涉及机器学习系统（10）。它被描述为给处理单元提供（110）输入数据。处理单元处理（120）输入数据以生成处理路径输入数据。处理单元实现（130）包括前馈神经网络的第一处理路径以处理所述处理路径输入数据以生成第一中间数据。处理单元实现（140）包括前馈神经网络的第二处理路径以处理所述处理路径输入数据以生成第二中间数据，其中第二处理路径是随机的。处理单元实现（150）包括前馈神经网络的价值输出路径以处理第一中间数据和第二中间数据以生成价值输出数据。处理单元实现（160）包括前馈神经网络的策略输出路径以处理第一中间数据和第二中间数据以生成策略输出数据。输出单元输出（170）价值输出数据和策略输出数据。 The invention relates to a machine learning system (10). It is described as providing (110) input data to a processing unit. The processing unit processes (120) the input data to generate processing path input data. A processing unit implementation (130) includes a first processing path of a feedforward neural network to process the processing path input data to generate first intermediate data. The processing unit implements (140) a second processing path comprising a feedforward neural network to process the processing path input data to generate second intermediate data, wherein the second processing path is random. The processing unit implements (150) a value output path including a feedforward neural network to process the first intermediate data and the second intermediate data to generate value output data. The processing unit implements (160) a policy output path including a feedforward neural network to process the first intermediate data and the second intermediate data to generate policy output data. The output unit outputs (170) the value output data and the policy output data.

title: 机器学习实例化
abstract: Aspects of the present disclosure relate to machine learning instantiation in which an instance of an agent (e.g., including processing user input by a machine learning model to generate model output) is packaged as an agent object. In an example, the agent object is stored as a file, document, database, and/or the like. The agent object includes a role definition and/or an object embedded memory to define various aspects of the agent. Thus, the agent object allows portability of the agent, e.g., between users, across contexts, and/or for various subsequent processes, etc. 本公开的各方面涉及机器学习实例化，其中智能体的实例(例如，包括由机器学习模型处理用户输入以生成模型输出)被封装为智能体对象。在示例中，智能体对象被存储为文件、文档和/或数据库等。智能体对象包括角色定义和/或对象嵌入存储器，从而定义智能体的各个方面。因此，智能体对象允许智能体的可移植性，例如在用户之间、跨上下文和/或用于各种后续处理等。

title: 机器学习框架
abstract: 本发明公开了一种机器学习框架，所述框架包括：数据结构模块，被配置为创建用于输入机器学习模型的张量数据，以及对所述张量数据执行运算；量子模块，被配置为创建用于创建机器学习模型的量子计算层；经典模块，被配置为创建用于创建机器学习模型的经典计算层、用于封装所述量子计算层和所述经典计算层的抽象类层、用于训练优化所述机器学习模型的机器学习模型训练层。该机器学习框架可以提高创建和训练包含量子计算层的机器学习模型的开发效率。 The invention discloses a machine learning framework, which comprises: a data structure module configured to create tensor data for input to a machine learning model, and perform an operation on the tensor data; a quantum module configured to create a quantum computing layer for creating a machine learning model; a classical module configured to create a classical computation layer for creating a machine learning model, an abstract class layer for encapsulating the quantum computation layer and the classical computation layer, a machine learning model training layer for training and optimizing the machine learning model. The machine learning framework can improve the development efficiency of creating and training machine learning models containing quantum computing layers.

abstract: The machine learning device includes a processor that processes data samples, and a storage device that stores results of the processing. The processor creates a plurality of identifiers from a plurality of learning databases. The plurality of learning databases respectively store a plurality of learning data samples. title: 机器学习接收器
abstract: 本公开的示例涉及产生训练或校准数据以供机器学习接收器使用。在一些示例中，数据节点从机器学习节点接收对生成随机比特序列的能力的指示。数据节点向机器学习节点发送用于生成随机比特序列的一个或多个参数。参数符合所指示的能力。数据节点还发送随机比特序列，其中随机比特序列根据所发送的参数被生成。 Examples of the present disclosure relate to generating training or calibration data for use by a machine learning receiver. In some examples, the data node receives an indication of an ability to generate a random bit sequence from the machine learning node. The data node sends one or more parameters for generating a random bit sequence to the machine learning node. The parameters conform to the indicated capabilities. The data node also transmits a random bit sequence, wherein the random bit sequence is generated according to the transmitted parameters.

abstract: The application discloses a lithium ion battery diaphragm and a lithium ion battery, wherein the lithium ion battery diaphragm comprises a base film, at least one surface of the base film is provided with a functional coating, the functional coating contains NTC material particles and ceramic particles, the mass content of the NTC material particles is 30-80 wt% based on the functional coating, the base film is a base film with low rupture temperature, and the rupture temperature of the base film is not higher than 180 ℃. The application uses the base film with low rupture temperature and negative temperature coefficient material to combine and match, so that in the early stage of thermal safety test (before failure), the base film with low rupture temperature forms a micro short circuit point, and then the NTC material and ceramic particle combined coating realizes large-area micro self-discharge, and the base film with low rupture temperature and NTC material in a certain range cooperate to realize controllable self-discharge rate, thereby being beneficial to quickly reducing the SOC of the battery and improving the thermal safety performance of the battery. 本申请公开了一种锂离子电池隔膜、锂离子电池，所述锂离子电池隔膜包括基膜，所述基膜的至少一表面设置有功能性涂层，所述功能性涂层含有NTC材料颗粒和陶瓷颗粒，以所述功能性涂层为基准，所述NTC材料颗粒的质量含量为30～80wt％，所述基膜为低破膜温度的基膜，所述基膜的破膜温度不高于180℃。本申请通过使用低破膜温度的基膜与负温度系数材料组合搭配使用，以使在热安全测试的前期(失效前)，由低破膜温度的基膜形成微短路点，再由NTC材料与陶瓷颗粒组合涂层实现大面积的微小自放电，通过低破膜温度的基膜与一定范围内的NTC材料的协同，可实现可控的自放电速率，有利于快速降低电池SOC，提升电池的热安全性能。
claims: 1. A lithium ion battery separator, comprising a base film; at least one surface of the base film is provided with a functional coating; The functional coating contains NTC material particles and ceramic particles; taking the functional coating as a reference, the mass content of the NTC material particles is 30-80 wt%; The rupture temperature of the base film is not higher than 180 ℃. 2. The lithium ion battery separator of claim 1, wherein at least one of the following conditions is satisfied: Condition I: the NTC material particles are selected from at least one of metal oxide particles having a spinel structure or metal oxide particles having a perovskite structure; The average particle diameter of the NTC material particles is marked as D 1 , the average particle diameter of the ceramic particles is marked as D 2 , and the conditions are satisfied: d 1 /D 2 is more than or equal to 1 and less than or equal to 25; and in the condition III, the rupture temperature of the base film is 135-180 ℃. 3. The lithium ion battery separator according to claim 2, wherein the NTC material particles are metal oxide particles having a spinel structure; the metal oxide particles with the spinel structure contain Mn element, O element and T element, wherein the T element is at least one selected from Ni element, fe element, cu element, co element or Zn element; Wherein the molar amount of the Mn element is denoted as n Mn , the molar amount of the T element is denoted as n T , and the following conditions are satisfied: n Mn /n T is more than or equal to 0.76 and less than or equal to 6.5. 4. The lithium ion battery separator according to claim 2, wherein the mass content of the NTC material particles is 50-80 wt%; the mass content of the ceramic particles ranges from 15 to 45 weight percent. 5. The lithium ion battery separator of claim 4, wherein at least one of the following conditions is satisfied: The condition A is that the average particle diameter D 1 of the NTC material particles is 0.5-2 mu m; And the average particle diameter D 2 of the ceramic particles is 0.1-0.5 mu m. 6. The lithium ion battery separator of claim 5, wherein at least one of the following conditions is satisfied: the condition a is that the average particle diameter D 1 of the NTC material particles is 0.5-1.5 mu m; The condition b is that the average particle diameter D 2 of the ceramic particles is 0.3-0.5 mu m. 7. The lithium ion battery separator of claim 1, wherein the lithium ion battery separator has a self-discharge rate of 120-260 mV/h at ambient temperatures above 120 ℃. 8. The lithium ion battery separator of claim 7, wherein the lithium ion battery separator has a self-discharge rate of 180-220 mV/h at ambient temperatures above 120 ℃. 9. The lithium ion battery separator of claim 1, wherein at least one of the following conditions is satisfied: Condition 1: the thickness of the base film is 3-6 mu m; Condition 2: the thickness of the functional coating is 2-8 mu m. 10. The lithium ion battery is characterized by comprising a positive pole piece, a negative pole piece, a diaphragm and electrolyte; the diaphragm is arranged between the positive pole piece and the negative pole piece; the separator is a lithium ion battery separator according to any one of claims 1 to 9; The positive plate contains a lithium cobaltate positive electrode material.

title: 锂离子电池组
abstract: 本实用新型涉及锂离子电池领域，公开了一种锂离子电池组，其包括：组合在一起的复数个锂离子电池单体，各锂离子电池单体的电极相串联或并联电连接；在各锂离子电池单体的电极所在端部，还设置有框架，框架套接在锂离子电池组的端部，在框架内填充有绝缘导热材料，各锂离子电池单体的电极以及电连接在各电极端的部件均被埋于绝缘导热材料内。 The utility model relates to field of lithium ion battery, disclose a kind of Li-ion batteries piles comprising: a plurality of lithium-ion battery monomers combined, the electrode of each lithium-ion battery monomer is connected in series or electrical connection in parallel；In end where the electrode of each lithium-ion battery monomer, it is additionally provided with frame, frame is socketed in the end of Li-ion batteries piles, insulating heat-conduction material is filled in frame, the electrode of each lithium-ion battery monomer and the component for being connected electrically in each electrode tip are embedded in insulating heat-conduction material.

Li-ion batteries piles according to claim 1, characterized in that Each electrode and it is connected electrically in the component of the electrode and the insulating heat-conduction material closely bonds.

title: 一种锂离子电池
applicants: ZHANGZHOU HUAWEI POWER SUPPLY TECH CO LTD
abstract: The utility model relates to a lithium ion battery, including battery case, lid, lithium ion battery board and controller, the controller includes microprocessor, current sampling module, electronic switch, electric quantity detection module, the lithium ion battery board is installed in battery case's mounting groove, the lid closes in the mounting groove, the lid surface is established first temperature sensor, the positive negative power port of lithium ion battery board is connected with the positive negative power port one-to-one on the lid, current sampling module series connection is between the positive power port of lithium ion battery board and the positive power port on the lid; the inner surface of the mounting groove is provided with a heat insulation material layer, the surface of the heat insulation material layer is provided with an electrothermal film, fluffy cotton is arranged in an interlayer between the lithium ion battery plate and the electrothermal film, and the surface of the lithium ion battery plate is also provided with a second temperature sensor; the circuit modules are connected in a matching way. When the temperature is lower than 0 ℃, the microprocessor controls the electronic switch to be switched on, and the electric heating film is electrified and heated, so that the lithium ion battery can be normally used. 本实用新型涉及一种锂离子电池，包括电池外壳、盖体、锂离子电池板和控制器，控制器包括微处理器、电流采样模块、电子开关、电量检测模块，锂离子电池板安装在电池外壳的安装槽内，盖体盖合在安装槽，盖体表面设第一温度传感器，锂离子电池板的正负极电源端口与盖体上的正负极电源端口一一对
claims: 1. A lithium ion battery, characterized by: the battery pack comprises a battery shell, a cover body, a lithium ion battery plate and a controller, wherein the controller comprises a microprocessor, a current sampling module, an electronic switch and an electric quantity detection module, a mounting groove for mounting the lithium ion battery plate and the controller is formed in the battery shell, the cover body covers the opening position of the mounting groove, a first temperature sensor is arranged on the upper surface of the cover body, a positive power port and a negative power port are formed in the cover body, the positive power port and the negative power port of the lithium ion battery plate are connected with the positive power port and the negative power port on the cover body in a one-to-one correspondence manner, and the current sampling module is connected between the positive power port of the lithium ion battery plate and the positive power port on the cover body in series; the inner surface of the mounting groove is provided with a heat insulation material layer, the surface of the heat insulation material layer is provided with an electrothermal film, an interlayer is formed between the lithium ion battery plate and the electrothermal film, fluffy cotton is arranged in the interlayer, and a second temperature sensor is also arranged on the surface of the lithium ion battery plate in the mounting groove; the power end and the electric quantity detection module of the microprocessor are respectively and electrically connected with the positive power port and the negative power port of the lithium ion battery plate, the first temperature sensor, the second temperature sensor, the electronic switch and the electric quantity detection module are respectively and electrically connected with the I/O end of the microprocessor, and the positive power port and the negative power port of the lithium ion battery plate are electrically connected with the electric heating film through the electronic switch to form a conductive loop. 2. A lithium ion battery according to claim 1, wherein: the cover body is further provided with a display screen, and the display screen is in communication connection with the microprocessor. 3. A lithium-ion battery according to claim 1 or 2, characterized in that: the controller further comprises a voltage sampling module, the voltage sampling module is electrically connected with the positive power port and the negative power port of the lithium ion battery plate, and the voltage sampling module is electrically connected with the I/O end of the microprocessor. 4. A lithium ion battery according to claim 3, wherein: the cover body is also provided with a loudspeaker, and the loudspeaker is electrically connected with an I/O end of the microprocessor.

title: 一种锂离子电池
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of lithium ion batteries, and discloses a lithium ion battery, which comprises a shell component, a positive pole column, a positive pole piece, a negative pole piece and electrolyte; the shell assembly comprises a shell and a cover plate, and the shell and the cover plate are in sealed welding connection; the shell is provided with a brim which is buckled on the cover plate, or the cover plate is provided with a brim which is buckled on the shell; the cover plate is provided with a connecting hole, the positive pole penetrates through the connecting hole and is arranged at an interval with the inner wall of the connecting hole, the first end of the positive pole is exposed out of the cover plate, and the second end of the positive pole extends into the shell; the positive plate is arranged in the shell and connected to the positive post; the negative plate is connected with the shell; electrolyte is injected into the shell. The shell and the cover plate are connected in a welding mode, so that the connection strength between the shell and the cover plate is high, the sealing performance of the welding sealing connection is high, and the electrolyte leakage phenomenon can be avoided. By arranging the positive pole column, the positive pole and the negative pole can be separated, and the normal use of the lithium ion battery can be ensured. 本实用新型涉及锂离子电池技术领域，公开了一种锂离子电池，包括壳体组件、正极柱、正极片、负极片及电解液；壳体组件包括壳体和盖板，壳体与盖板密封焊接连接；壳体上设置有帽檐，帽檐扣于盖
claims: 1. A lithium ion battery, comprising: the shell assembly (1) comprises a shell (11) and a cover plate (12), wherein the shell (11) is connected with the cover plate (12) in a sealing and welding mode; a cap peak (111) is arranged on the shell (11), the cap peak (111) is buckled on the cover plate (12), or the cover plate (12) is provided with the cap peak (111), and the cap peak (111) is buckled on the shell (11); the cover plate (12) is provided with a connecting hole (121), the positive pole (2) penetrates through the connecting hole (121) and is arranged at an interval with the inner wall of the connecting hole (121), the first end of the positive pole (2) is exposed out of the cover plate (12), and the second end of the positive pole extends into the shell (11); a positive electrode tab (3) which is provided in the case (11) and connected to the positive electrode post (2); a negative electrode sheet connected to the case (11); electrolyte is injected into the shell (11). 2. The lithium ion battery according to claim 1, further comprising a first insulating sheet (4), wherein the first end of the positive post (2) is provided with a contact protrusion (21) outwardly, the outer side of the cover plate (12) is provided with a receiving groove (122), the inner diameter of the receiving groove (122) is larger than the outer diameter of the contact protrusion (21), the first insulating sheet (4) is arranged in the receiving groove (122), and the bottom surface of the contact protrusion (21) abuts against the first insulating sheet (4). 3. The lithium ion battery according to claim 2, further comprising a second insulating sheet (5), wherein the positive electrode sheet (3) is connected to the second end of the positive electrode post (2), and the second insulating sheet (5) is disposed between the positive electrode sheet (3) and the cover plate (12). 4. The lithium ion battery according to claim 1, characterized in that an explosion-proof wire is provided on the housing (11). 5. The lithium ion battery according to claim 1, characterized in that the cover plate (12) is provided with an explosion-proof wire or an explosion-proof sheet. 6. The lithium ion battery according to claim 1, wherein the visor (111) is an arc-shaped groove. 7. The lithium ion battery according to claim 1, wherein the visor (111) is an "L" shaped groove. 8. The lithium ion battery according to claim 1, wherein the visor (111) is flat. 9. abstract: A lithium ion battery comprises a positive electrode, a negative electrode and a separation film, wherein the positive electrode comprises a first current collector, a positive electrode active material layer and a first carbon material layer arranged between the first current collector and the positive electrode active material layer, the negative electrode comprises a second current collector, a negative electrode active material layer and a second carbon material layer arranged between the second current collector and the negative electrode active material layer, and the separation film is clamped between the positive electrode and the negative electrode, wherein the first carbon material layer and the second carbon material layer are graphene layers respectively, the graphene layers have a diameter of L a between 1 mu m and 50 mu m and a number of layers between 1 mu m and 10 mu m, and L a is a value obtained by Raman spectroscopy. 一种锂离子电池，包括一正电极、一负电极及一隔离膜，该正电极包括一第一集流器、一正电极活性材料层及一设置在该第一集流器与该正电极活性材料层之间的第一碳材料层；该负电极包括一第二集流器、一负电极活性材料层及一设置在该第二集流器与该负电极活性材料层之间的第二碳材料层，该隔离膜夹设在该正电极与该负电极之间，其中，该第一碳材料层和该第二碳材料层分别为一石墨烯层，该石墨烯层具有一La介于1μm至50μm之间的直径以及一介于1至10之间的层数，其中La为一由拉曼光谱所获得的值。

title: 一种锂离子电池
abstract: 本实用新型涉及一种锂离子电池，所述锂离子电池包括锂离子电池本体与压力检测装置，所述压力检测装置包括PVDF压电薄膜传感器，所述PVDF压电薄膜传感器设置于所述锂离子电池本体表面，以检测锂离子电池表面的压力变化。通过在锂离子电池外壳贴合PVDF压电薄膜传感器的方式，可快速检测锂离子电池外部压力的变化，既方便又快捷，可有效防止安全事故的发生，且PVDF压电薄膜传感器，其反应灵敏，制作方便，使用成本较低。 The utility model relates to a lithium ion battery, lithium ion battery includes lithium ion battery body and pressure measurement, pressure measurement includes PVDF piezoelectric film sensor, PVDF piezoelectric film sensor set up in lithium ion battery body surface to detect the pressure change on lithium ion battery surface. Through the mode of laminating PVDF piezoelectric film sensor at lithium ion battery shell, but the change of short-term test lithium ion battery external pressure, it is not only convenient but also swift, can effectively prevent the emergence of incident, and PVDF piezoelectric film sensor, its reaction is sensitive, and the preparation is convenient, and use cost is lower.
claims: 1. A lithium ion battery, characterized by: the lithium ion battery comprises a lithium ion battery body and a pressure detection device, wherein the pressure detection device comprises a PVDF piezoelectric film sensor, and the PVDF piezoelectric film sensor is arranged on the surface of the lithium ion battery body so as to detect the pressure change on the surface of the lithium ion battery. 2. The lithium ion battery of claim 1, wherein: the PVDF piezoelectric film sensor comprises a lower electrode, a PVDF film and an upper electrode, wherein the lower electrode, the PVDF film and the upper electrode are sequentially connected. 3. A lithium ion battery according to claim 2, wherein: the length of the PVDF piezoelectric film sensor is 15mm-120 mm; the width of the PVDF piezoelectric film sensor is 15mm-60 mm. 4. A lithium ion battery according to claim 2, wherein: the thickness d1 of the lower electrode is 5um-40 um; the thickness d2 of the PVDF film is 8um-35 um; the thickness d3 of the lower electrode can be 15um-45 um. 5. The lithium ion battery of claim 4, wherein: the lower electrode comprises a polyimide film, the polyimide film is arranged on the surface of the lithium ion battery body, and the thickness of the polyimide film is 1um-5 um. 6. A lithium ion battery according to claim 2, wherein: the surface of the lithium ion battery body comprises an end face and an outer peripheral face, and the PVDF piezoelectric film sensor covers the outer peripheral face of the lithium ion battery body; the ratio of the area of the PVDF piezoelectric film sensor to the area of the outer peripheral surface of the lithium ion battery body is 1/2-9/10. 7. The lithium ion battery of claim 1, wherein: the pressure detection device is also provided with a miniature pressure sensor which is arranged inside the lithium ion battery body so as to detect the internal pressure change of the lithium ion battery. 8. The lithium ion battery of claim 1, wherein: the lithium ion battery body comprises an electric core and a soft package shell, and the electric core is accommodated in the soft package shell; the battery cell comprises a positive plate, a negative plate and a diaphragm, wherein the diaphragm is arranged between the positive plate and the negative plate. 9. The lithium ion battery of claim 8, wherein: the positive plate comprises a positive substrate, and the positive substrate is any one of aluminum foil, aluminum mesh and graphene; the negative plate comprises a negative substrate, and the negative substrate is any one of copper foil, copper mesh and graphene. 10. The lithium ion battery of any of claims 1-9, wherein: the lithium ion battery body is characterized by further comprising a heat dissipation aluminum plate, and the heat dissipation aluminum plate is arranged on the outer side of the lithium ion battery body.

abstract: 本实用新型提供一种锂离子电池，包括由带正极耳的正极、隔离膜和带负极耳的负极通过叠片和/或卷绕形成的裸电芯、封装所述裸电芯的壳体以及粘贴在所述裸电芯和所述壳体之间的热熔双面胶；所述热熔双面胶的粘贴面积为所述裸电芯被粘贴面的面积的60～90％，所述热熔双面胶上还设置有若干排气孔。相比于现有技术，本实用新型通过增大热熔双面胶的面积，利用大面积来增强裸电芯与壳体之间的粘结力，同时分散集中应力，保证了在定向跌落时不会因为电池的重力冲击而导致裸电芯与壳体粘结处的应力过大而撕裂壳体，解决了大容量电芯因贴胶面积小而导致撕裂裸电芯保护层的问题；另外，通过设置有多个排气孔，导出因贴胶面积过大而产生的气泡。 The utility model provides a lithium ion battery, which comprises a naked battery cell formed by an anode with an anode lug, an isolating membrane and a cathode with a cathode lug through lamination and/or winding, a shell for packaging the naked battery cell and a hot melt double faced adhesive tape adhered between the naked battery cell and the shell; the sticking area of hot melt double faced adhesive tape does naked electric core is by 60 ~ 90% of the area of sticking the face, still be provided with a plurality of exhaust holes on the hot melt double faced adhesive tape. Compared with the prior art, the utility model discloses an increase the area of hot melt double faced adhesive tape, utilize the large tracts of land to strengthen the cohesive force between naked electric core and the casing, disperse the concentrated stress simultaneously, guaranteed that can not lead to because of the gravity impact of battery when the orientation falls that the stress of naked electric core and casing bonding department is too big tears the casing, solved the problem that the large capacity electric core leads to tearing naked electric core protective layer because the rubberizing area is li
claims: 1. A lithium ion battery is characterized by comprising a naked battery cell formed by laminating and/or winding a positive electrode with a positive electrode lug, an isolating membrane and a negative electrode with a negative electrode lug, a shell for packaging the naked battery cell and a hot-melt double-sided adhesive tape adhered between the naked battery cell and the shell; the sticking area of the hot-melt double-sided adhesive tape is 60-90% of the area of the stuck surface of the bare cell, and the hot-melt double-sided adhesive tape is provided with a plurality of exhaust holes. 2. The lithium ion battery of claim 1, wherein the bonding area of the hot-melt double-sided adhesive tape is 68-82% of the bonded area of the bare cell. 3. The lithium ion battery of claim 1, wherein the hot melt double-sided adhesive tape is further provided with a groove, and the groove is arranged at one end of the hot melt double-sided adhesive tape close to the positive tab and the negative tab. 4. The lithium ion battery of claim 3, wherein the groove is disposed around and mates with the positive tab. 5. The lithium ion battery of claim 3, wherein the groove is disposed around and mates with the negative tab. 6. The lithium ion battery of claim 3, wherein the groove is disposed around the positive tab and the negative tab to simultaneously surround the positive tab and the negative tab. 7. The lithium ion battery of claim 3, wherein the groove comprises a first groove disposed around and mating with the positive tab and a second groove disposed around and mating with the negative tab. 8. The lithium ion battery of claim 1, wherein the hot-melt double-sided adhesive tape comprises a protective layer, a first adhesive layer, a substrate layer and a second adhesive layer which are arranged in sequence. 9. The lithium ion battery of claim 8, wherein the protective layer is a styrene-isoprene polymer layer, the first glue layer and the second glue layer are both hydrogenated styrene-isoprene polymer layers, and the substrate layer is a PET layer. 10. The lithium ion battery of claim 8, wherein the protective layer has a thickness of 2-4 μm, the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer have a thickness of 10-18 μm, and the substrate layer has a thickness of 10-15 μm.

title: 一种锂离子电池
abstract: 为克服现有三电极体系应用于动力电池检测性能不足的问题，本实用新型提供了一种锂离子电池，包括封装容器以及封装于所述封装容器中的电芯和参比电极，所述电芯包括层叠的正极片、负极片和第一隔膜，所述正极片和所述负极片由所述第一隔膜相互分隔，所述电芯的最外层为第一隔膜，所述参比电极设置于所述电芯的外侧，所述正极片，所述负极片和所述参比电极由所述封装容器电引出。本实用新型提供的锂离子电池有利于提高参比电极的测试稳定性，同时，在保持电池极芯的成型方式不变的情况下，降低加工难度。 For overcoming the current problem that the three electrode system is applied to power battery detection performance not enough, the utility model provides a lithium ion battery, including packaging container and encapsulate in electric core and reference electrode among the packaging container, electric core includes range upon range of positive plate, negative pole piece and first diaphragm, positive plate with the negative pole piece by first diaphragm separates each other, the outmost first diaphragm that is of electric core, the reference electrode set up in the outside of electric core, positive plate, the negative pole piece with the reference electrode by the packaging container electricity is drawn forth. The utility model provides a lithium ion battery is favorable to improving reference electrode's test stability, simultaneously, under the unchangeable condition of the shaping mode that keeps the battery utmost point core, reduces the processing degree of difficulty.
claims: 1. The utility model provides a lithium ion battery, its characterized in that, including packaging container and encapsulate in electric core and reference electrode among the packaging container, electric core includes range upon range of positive plate, negative pole piece and first diaphragm, positive plate with negative pole piece by first diaphragm separates each other, the outmost first diaphragm that is of electric core, the reference electrode set up in the outside of electric core, positive plate, negative pole piece with the reference electrode by the packaging container electricity is drawn forth. 2. The lithium ion battery of claim 1, wherein the reference electrode is externally wrapped with a second separator, and the second separator is fixed to the first separator at the outermost layer of the cell. 3. The lithium ion battery of claim 1, wherein the packaging container comprises a cover plate and a metal shell, the battery cell is disposed in the metal shell, the metal shell is provided with an opening, and the cover plate encapsulates the opening of the metal shell. 4. The lithium ion battery of claim 3, wherein the cover plate is provided with a reference electrode column, and a first conductor is arranged between the reference electrode column and the reference electrode to be electrically connected with each other. 5. The lithium ion battery of claim 3, wherein the reference electrode is electrically connected to the metal casing. 6. The lithium ion battery according to claim 4 or 5, wherein a positive post and a negative post are arranged on the cover plate, a second conductor is arranged between the positive plate and the positive post to be electrically connected with each other, and a third conductor is arranged between the negative plate and the negative post to be electrically connected with each other. 7. The lithium ion battery according to claim 6, wherein the positive plate comprises a positive current collector and a positive material layer, a positive coating area and a positive blank area are formed on the positive current collector, and the positive material layer is coated on the positive coating area; the negative pole piece includes negative pole mass flow body and negative pole material layer, be formed with negative coating district and negative pole blank region on the negative pole mass flow body, the negative pole material layer coat in on the negative coating district. 8. The lithium ion battery of claim 7, wherein the battery core is formed by laminating the positive electrode sheet, the negative electrode sheet and the first diaphragm, the positive electrode coating area and the negative electrode coating area are stacked, and the positive electrode blank area and the negative electrode blank area are led out from the same end of the battery core. 9. The lithium ion battery of claim 7, wherein the battery core is formed by winding the positive plate, the negative plate and the first diaphragm, the positive coating area and the negative coating area are stacked and then wound, the positive blank area and the negative blank area are respectively located at two ends of the battery core, the positive blank area is welded into a whole after being wound, a first nickel plate is welded on the outer side of the positive blank area, and the positive plate is electrically led out from the first nickel plate; the negative pole blank region is welded into a whole after being wound, a second nickel sheet is welded on the outer side of the negative pole blank region, and the negative pole sheet is electrically led out from the second nickel sheet. 10. The lithium ion battery of claim 1, wherein the reference electrode comprises a reference current collector and a lithium iron phosphate layer, a reference coating area and a reference blank area are formed on the reference current collector, the lithium iron phosphate layer is coated on the reference coating area, a third nickel sheet is welded on the reference blank area, and the reference electrode is electrically led out from the third nickel sheet.

title: 一种锂离子电池

title: 锂离子电池
