title: 一种锂离子电池
abstract: 本实用新型涉及构造一种锂离子电池，包括电池壳、收容于所述电池壳中的电芯、以及填充于所述电池壳中的电解液；所述电芯由依次层叠设置的第一隔膜、正极片、第二隔膜、负极片热敷合形成一体结构的复合片卷绕形成。该锂离子电池的电芯由依次层叠设置的第一隔膜、正极片、第二隔膜、负极片热敷合形成一体结构的复合片卷绕形成，从而可提高卷绕效率，避免第一隔膜、正极片、第二隔膜、负极片出现错位，同时可减少人手接触进而避免粉尘和水汽的影响，实现最大限度的提高锂电池的品质，并且可以省去模切工艺，进而可减小毛刺产生，从而避免电池出现低压断裂的风险。 The utility model relates to a lithium ion battery, which comprises a battery shell, an electric core contained in the battery shell and electrolyte filled in the battery shell; the battery core is formed by winding a composite sheet which is sequentially stacked and is of an integrated structure formed by hot compressing a first diaphragm, a positive plate, a second diaphragm and a negative plate. This lithium ion battery's electric core is by the first diaphragm that stacks gradually the setting, the positive plate, the second diaphragm, negative pole piece hot compress closes the compound piece of formation body structure and convolutes and form, thereby can improve coiling efficiency, avoid first diaphragm, the positive plate, the second diaphragm, the dislocation appears in the negative pole piece, reducible staff contact further and avoid the influence of dust and steam simultaneously, realize furthest's the quality of improvement lithium cell, and can save cross cutting technology, and then can reduce the burr and produce, thereby avoid the low pressure cracked risk to appear in the battery.
claims: 1. The lithium ion battery is characterized by comprising a battery shell, a battery cell accommodated in the battery shell and electrolyte filled in the battery shell; the battery core is formed by winding a composite sheet (100) which is formed into an integral structure through hot lamination of a first diaphragm (100b), a positive plate (100a), a second diaphragm (100d) and a negative plate (100c) which are sequentially stacked. 2. The lithium ion battery according to claim 1, characterized in that one side of the first separator (100b) is coated with a hot-melt material; the side of the first separator (100b) coated with the hot-melt material is disposed opposite to the positive electrode tab (100 a). 3. The lithium ion battery according to claim 1, wherein both sides of the second separator (100d) are coated with a hot-melt material in contact with the positive electrode sheet (100a) and the negative electrode sheet (100 c). 4. The lithium ion battery of claim 2 or 3, wherein the hot melt material comprises polyvinylidene fluoride hexafluoropropylene. 5. The lithium ion battery according to claim 1, wherein the width of the composite sheet (100) is 2-350 mm. 6. The lithium ion battery according to claim 1, wherein the first separator (100b) and the second separator (100d) are arranged in alignment; the first diaphragm (100b), positive plate (100a), second diaphragm (100d), negative pole piece (100c) form the compound piece of an organic whole structure through adopting the hot compress of the piece equipment of applying system of applying. 7. The lithium ion battery according to claim 1, wherein the heat sealing temperature is 45-85 ℃; and/or the pressure applied to the composite sheet (100) during hot compression is 1T-2T. 8. The lithium ion battery according to claim 1, wherein the positive electrode sheet (100a) comprises a positive electrode substrate and a positive electrode material coated on the positive electrode substrate; and/or the negative plate (100c) comprises a negative electrode substrate and a negative electrode material coated on the negative plate (100 c). 9. The lithium ion battery according to claim 1, wherein both ends of the battery cell are respectively provided with a positive tab (110) and a negative tab (120); the positive tab (110) is arranged on the positive plate (100 a); the negative electrode tab (120) is disposed on the negative electrode sheet (100 c). 10. The lithium ion battery of claim 1, wherein the battery enclosure comprises an upper cover and a lower cover mated with the upper cover.

title: 一种锂离子电池
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of the lithium cell package, especially, relate to a lithium ion battery. The embodiment of the utility model provides an in, the swelling layer sets up utmost point core with between the casing, after injecting into electrolyte among the lithium ion battery, the swelling part is soaked the back inflation by electrolyte, under the prerequisite of guaranteeing insulating nature, has indirectly improved the area of contact of utmost point core and aluminum hull, reduces thermal contact resistance, improves the radiating efficiency, and the life-span improves the battery security performance to guarantee the maneuverability of production process utmost point core cover shell, the cover shell of can relaxing. 本实用新型属于锂电池包技术领域，特别是涉及一种锂离子电池。锂离子电池包括包括壳体及容纳在所述壳体内的极芯及溶胀部件，所述溶胀部件设置在所述极芯与壳体的内壁之间以隔离所述极芯和壳体，所述溶胀部件可在浸润电解液后发生溶胀。本实用新型实施例中，所述溶胀层设置在所述极芯与所述壳体之间，锂离子电池中注入电解液后，所述溶胀部件被电解液浸润后膨胀，在保证绝缘性的前提下，间接提高了极芯与铝壳的接触面积，减小接触热阻，提高散热效率，提高寿命，提高电池安全性能，并且保证了生产过程极芯套壳的可操作性，可轻松套壳。
claims: 1. The lithium ion battery is characterized by comprising a shell, a pole core and a swelling component, wherein the pole core and the swelling component are accommodated in the shell, the swelling component is arranged between the pole core and the inner wall of the shell to separate the pole core from the shell, and the swelling component can swell after being soaked in electrolyte. 2. The lithium ion battery according to claim 2, wherein the insulating member is a side spacer, and the swelling member includes a first swelling layer for filling a gap between the side spacer and the pole core and a second swelling layer for filling a gap between the side spacer and the case. 4. The lithium ion battery of claim 3, wherein the side spacer includes a main plate, a side plate, and a bottom plate, the main plate being disposed parallel to an end side face of the pole core, the side plate extending along a side edge of the main plate in a direction perpendicular to the main plate, the side plate being disposed parallel to a large face of the pole core, the bottom plate extending along a bottom edge of the main plate in a direction perpendicular to the main plate. 5. The lithium ion battery according to claim 4, wherein the first swelling layer is sprayed on an inner side of the main plate, and the second swelling layer is sprayed or stuck on an inner wall of the case on a side parallel to an end side of the main plate. 7. The lithium ion battery of claim 1, wherein the casing is an aluminum casing. 8. The lithium ion battery of claim 2, wherein the insulator is an insulating sleeve, the swelling member is a third swelling layer, the insulating sleeve is sleeved on the periphery of the pole core, the third swelling layer is located between the insulating sleeve and the casing, and the third swelling layer is adhered to the inner wall of the casing in a direction parallel to the end side surface of the pole core.

abstract: 本发明涉及锂离子电池，具体涉及锂离子电池及其制备方法，属于能源材料技术领域。该锂离子电池包括正极、负极、隔膜、有机电解液及电池外壳，所述正极包括如下重量份的组分：正极活性物质：85‑95份，导电剂：2‑5份，PVDF粘结剂：5‑10份，PVP试剂：5‑10份，PEG：110～130份，二氟氧化钛：5‑10份。本发明通过在锂离子电池正极中加入PVP试剂，同时通过调节其他组分的含量，使正极浆料的粘度合适、流动性和分散性良好，且减少了PEG的使用量和匀浆时间，大幅度降低了锂离子电池的成本同时提升了制程效率。 The invention relates to a lithium ion battery, in particular to a lithium ion battery and a preparation method thereof, belonging to the technical field of energy materials. abstract: 本实用新型涉及电池的技术领域，尤其是涉及一种锂离子电池，包括封装体和置于封装体内的电芯本体，所述电芯本体设有用于增加电子进出电芯本体的通道的导电体组件，所述导电体组件包括设置在电芯本体两侧的第一导电体和第二导电体，所述第一导电体折叠并与电芯本体和第二导电体接触。本实用新型设计科学合理，结构简单，与现有技术相比，第一导电体和第二导电体的设置，能够有效的增大电子进出电芯本体的通道，使得更多的电子能够同时进出电芯本体，以达到增大电芯本体充放电倍率的效果，从而提高电池的充放电倍率的性能。 The utility model belongs to the technical field of the technique of battery and specifically relates to a lithium ion battery is related to, including the packaging body and arrange the internal electric core body of packaging in, electric core body is equipped with the electric conductor subassembly that is used for increasing the passageway of electron business turn over electric core body, the electric conductor subassembly is including setting up first electric conductor and the second electric conductor in electric core body both sides, first electric conductor is folding and contact with electric core body and second electric conductor. title: 一种锂离子电池

abstract: 本发明涉及一种锂离子电池，具体涉及一种移动电源用高安全快充型锂离子电池，属于锂离子电池材料领域。本发明锂离子电池包括正极、负极、隔膜、电解液及电池外壳，所述正极包括集流体以及涂覆在集流体表面的正极材料，所述正极材料中的正极活性物质为NCM811和锰酸锂的混合物，且两者的份数比为(2‑3)：1。本发明采取NCM811与锰酸锂材料复合使用，利用NCM811优异的循环、高温、高克容量及压实结合锰酸锂高的电压平台及优异的低温、倍率及加工性能，降低移动电源成本，延长其使用寿命，提升其快充性能。 The invention relates to a lithium ion battery, in particular to a high-safety quick-charging lithium ion battery for a mobile power supply, and belongs to the field of lithium ion battery materials. The lithium ion battery comprises a positive electrode, a negative electrode, a diaphragm, electrolyte and a battery shell, wherein the positive electrode comprises a current collector and a positive electrode material coated on the surface of the current collector, a positive electrode active substance in the positive electrode material is a mixture of NCM811 and lithium manganate, and the part ratio of the NCM811 to the lithium manganate is (2-3): 1. according to the invention, NCM811 and the lithium manganate material are used in a composite manner, and the excellent cycle, high temperature and high gram capacity of NCM811, and the high voltage platform of lithium manganate and the excellent low temperature, rate and processing performance are combined in a compaction manner, so that the cost of the mobile power supply is reduced, the service life of the mobile power supply is prolonged, and the quick charging performance of the mobile power supply is improved.

In addition, related raw materials do not need to be imported, and the method is beneficial to localization.

abstract: 本发明涉及一种锂离子电池，其负极复合材料通过如下步骤制备得到：在50～70℃下，将硅烷前驱体、粘结剂、分散剂和水混合，搅拌反应5～15分钟，然后加入纳米硅粉，搅拌反应20～40分钟，然后调整反应体系的pH为3～4，在0～40℃下静置反应1.5～2.5小时，得到含有中间体颗粒的悬浮液；向悬浮液中加入石墨和/或针状焦，搅拌混合0.5～1.5小时，然后进行喷雾干燥，得到中间材料，其中，控制喷雾干燥的进口温度为210～320℃，出口温度为80～130℃；将中间材料在惰性气氛的保护下，在600～1200℃下进行氧化还原反应2～10小时，制得负极复合材料。本发明的锂离子电池的循环性能和库伦效率好。 The invention relates to a lithium ion battery, wherein a negative electrode composite material is prepared by the following steps: mixing a silane precursor, a binder, a dispersing agent and water at 50-70 ℃, stirring for reaction for 5-15 minutes, adding nano silicon powder, stirring for reaction for 20-40 minutes, adjusting the pH of a reaction system to 3-4, and standing for reaction for 1.5-2.5 hours at 0-40 ℃ to obtain a suspension containing intermediate particles; adding graphite and/or needle coke into the suspension, stirring and mixing for 0.5-1.5 hours, and then performing spray drying to obtain an intermediate material, wherein the inlet temperature of the spray drying is controlled to be 210-320 ℃, and the outlet temperature is controlled to be 80-130 ℃; and carrying out oxidation-reduction reaction on the intermediate material at 600-1200 ℃ for 2-10 hours under the protection of inert atmosphere to obtain the cathode composite material. abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of batteries, in particular to a lithium ion battery, compared with the prior art, the lithium ion battery provided by the utility model has a multi-layer structure welding section, each layer of welding section is welded with a steel shell together in a corresponding position, so that a melting layer formed after welding is thickened, the corresponding shear strength and tensile strength are effectively improved, when a battery cell shakes or twists in the steel shell, the multi-layer welding section can share shear force, thereby reducing the load of the welding section directly welded with the steel shell, effectively avoiding the direct perforation and desoldering of the melting layer, even if the perforation and desoldering is carried out at first in the welding section far away from the steel shell, the welding section directly welded with the steel shell can also be connected with the steel shell, and can play a role of spring buffering when the battery falls, and effectively filtering a part of impact, thereby improving the impact resistance of the battery. 本实用新型属于电池技术领域，具体为一种锂离子电池，与现有技术相比，本实用新型提供的锂离子电池具有多层结构的焊接段，各层焊接段在对应的位置与钢壳熔接在一起，因此使焊接后形成的熔融层变厚，其相应的抗剪切强度和抗拉强度也得到有效的提高，当电芯在钢壳内部发生晃动或扭转时，多层的焊接段会分担剪切力，从而减轻直接与钢壳熔接的焊接段的负荷，有效地避免熔融层直接穿孔脱焊，即使穿孔脱焊也是远离钢壳的焊接段先发生脱离，直接与钢壳熔接的焊接段还能保持与钢壳连接，并且可以起到类似弹簧缓冲的效果，在电池跌落时可起到弹簧缓冲的作用，有效地过滤掉一部分的冲击，从而提升电池的抗冲击能力。

abstract: 本实用新型涉及一种锂离子电池，其包括：电池芯、第一电池盖、第二电池盖和可拆卸组件，所述第一电池盖和所述第二电池盖分别盖合于电池芯的相对两侧，所述可拆卸组件分别连接于所述第一电池盖和所述第二电池盖，所述可拆卸组件供所述第一电池盖和所述第二电池盖可拆卸连接。当需要装配锂离子电池时，工作人员将电池芯的相对两侧分别放置在第一电池盖和第二电池盖之间，进而第一电池盖和第二电池盖分别盖合于电池芯的相对两侧，利用可拆卸组件，使得第一电池盖和第二电池盖之间保持固定状态，直接减少了装配锂离子电池时需要将电池芯插入壳套中的步骤。本实用新型的锂离子电池，其可以防止电池芯出现损伤的情况发生。 The utility model relates to a lithium ion battery, it includes: the battery comprises a battery core, a first battery cover, a second battery cover and a detachable assembly, wherein the first battery cover and the second battery cover are respectively covered on two opposite sides of the battery core, the detachable assembly is respectively connected with the first battery cover and the second battery cover, and the detachable assembly is used for detachably connecting the first battery cover and the second battery cover. When the lithium ion battery needs to be assembled, a worker places the two opposite sides of the battery core between the first battery cover and the second battery cover respectively, then the first battery cover and the second battery cover the two opposite sides of the battery core respectively, and the detachable assembly is utilized to keep the first battery cover and the second battery cover in a fixed state, so that the step of inserting the battery core into the shell sleeve when the lithium ion battery is assembled is directly reduced. claims: 1. A lithium ion battery, comprising: the battery comprises a battery core (1), a first battery cover (2), a second battery cover (3) and a detachable component, wherein the first battery cover (2) and the second battery cover (3) cover opposite sides of the battery core (1) respectively, the detachable component is connected to the first battery cover (2) and the second battery cover (3) respectively, and the detachable component supplies the first battery cover (2) and the second battery cover (3) to be detachably connected. 2. The lithium ion battery of claim 1, wherein: the detachable component comprises an inserting block (4), the inserting block (4) is fixedly connected with the first battery cover (2), the second battery cover (3) is provided with an inserting hole (34), the inserting hole (34) supplies the inserting block (4) to be in inserting fit, and the inserting block (4) is in transition fit with the inserting hole (34). 3. The lithium ion battery of claim 2, wherein: the number of the inserting blocks (4) is two, the two inserting blocks (4) are respectively located on two opposite sides of the first battery cover (2), and the number of the inserting holes (34) is the same as that of the inserting blocks (4). 4. The lithium ion battery of claim 2, wherein: the first battery cover (2) comprises a first cover plate (21) and a first supporting leg (22), the first cover plate (21) is perpendicular to the first supporting leg (22), the first cover plate (21) and the first supporting leg (22) are enclosed to form a first accommodating groove (23), and the first accommodating groove (23) is used for accommodating one side of the battery core (1). 5. The lithium ion battery of claim 4, wherein: the second battery cover (3) comprises a second cover plate (31) and second supporting legs (32), the second cover plate (31) is perpendicular to the second supporting legs (32), the second cover plate (31) and the second supporting legs (32) are enclosed to form a second accommodating groove (33), and the second accommodating groove (33) is used for accommodating one side, deviating from the first accommodating groove (23), of the battery core (1). 6. The lithium ion battery of claim 5, wherein: the number of the first supporting legs (22) and the number of the second supporting legs (32) are two, the first supporting legs (22) are fixedly connected to the two opposite sides of the first cover plate (21) respectively, and the second supporting legs (32) are fixedly connected to the two opposite sides of the second cover plate (31) respectively. 7. The lithium ion battery of claim 6, wherein: the first supporting leg (22) and the second supporting leg (32) are both stainless steel supporting legs. 8. The lithium ion battery according to claim 5, wherein the first cover plate (21) and the second cover plate (31) each have a thickness in the range of 0.1mm to 0.5mm. 9. The lithium ion battery according to claim 5, characterized in that the thickness of the battery cell (1) is 0.8 to 1.0 times the distance between the first cover plate (21) and the second cover plate (31).

title: 锂离子电池
abstract: 一种锂离子电池包括正极和负极，以及在电解质溶液中浸泡并设置在电极之间的纳米孔或微孔聚合物隔膜。包括至少两种不同的螯合剂并选择它们与以下离子络合：i)两种或更多种不同的过渡金属离子；ii)呈两种或更多种不同氧化态的过渡金属离子；或iii)，i)和ii)两者。所述至少两种不同的选择的螯合剂以足以在电池操作期间不影响锂离子移动穿过隔膜的方式与过渡金属离子络合。螯合剂：溶解或分散于电解质溶液中；接枝到隔膜的聚合物上；附着在负极和/或正极的粘合剂材料；设置在隔膜的孔内；涂覆在隔膜的表面上；和/或涂覆在电极的表面上。 A lithium ion battery includes a positive electrode and a negative electrode, and a nanoporous or microporous polymer separator soaked in an electrolyte solution and disposed between the electrodes. Comprising at least two different chelating agents and selected to complex with: i) two or more different transition metal ions; ii) transition metal ions in two or more different oxidation states; or iii) both i) and ii). The at least two different selected chelating agents complex with the transition metal ions in a manner sufficient to not affect movement of lithium ions through the separator during operation of the battery. Chelating agent: dissolved or dispersed in an electrolyte solution; a polymer grafted to the separator; a binder material attached to the negative electrode and/or the positive electrode; disposed within the aperture of the septum; coating on a surface of the separator; and/or coated on the surface of the electrode.

abstract: 本申请提供了一种锂离子电池，所述锂离子电池包括电极组件以及电解液，所述电极组件包括正极极片、负极极片以及隔离膜。所述正极极片中的正极活性材料包含LixCoyM1‑yO2‑zQz，LixCoyM1‑yO2为大颗粒和小颗粒的混合物，大颗粒LixCoyM1‑yO2‑zQz的平均粒径D50为10μm～17μm，小颗粒LixCoyM1‑yO2‑zQz的平均粒径D50为2μm～7μm。所述电解液中含有添加剂A，所述添加剂A为氧化电位较低的多腈基六元氮杂环化合物。本申请的锂离子电池具有优异的循环性能和存储性能，尤其是在高温高电压情况下具有优异的循环性能和存储性能。 The application provides a lithium ion battery, lithium ion battery includes electrode subassembly and electrolyte, electrode subassembly includes positive pole piece, negative pole piece and barrier film. abstract: The invention provides a lithium ion battery. The lithium ion battery includes a battery case, an electrolyte, and an electrode assembly. The electrolyte comprises lithium salt and an organic solvent, and the electrode assembly comprises a positive plate, a negative plate and an isolating membrane. The positive plate comprises a positive current collector and a positive membrane which is arranged on at least one surface of the positive current collector and comprises a positive active material, and the negative plate comprises a negative current collector and a negative membrane which is arranged on at least one surface of the negative current collector and comprises a negative active material. The lithium salt comprises one or more compounds shown as a formula I, wherein n is an integer from 1 to 3, and Rf 1 And Rf 2 Is C m F 2m+1 Wherein m is an integer of 0 to 5, Rf 1 、Rf 2 The lithium ion batteries are the same or different, and the group margin of the lithium ion batteries is 85-95%. The lithium ion battery has the advantages of good cycle performance, good rate performance, high safety performance and good low-temperature discharge performance. 本发明提供一种锂离子电池。所述锂离子电池包括电池壳体、电解液以及电极组件。所述电解液包括锂盐以及有机溶剂，所述电极组件由正极片、负极片以及隔离膜组成。所述正极片包括正极集流体以及设置于正极集流体至少一个表面上且包括正极活性材料的正极膜片，所述负极片包括负极集流体以及设置于负极集流体至少一个表面上且包括负极活性材料的负极膜片。所述锂盐包括式I所示的化合物中的一种或几种，其中，n为1～3内的整数，Rf1和Rf2是CmF2m+1，其中m为0～5内的整数，Rf1、Rf2相同或不同，所述锂离子电池的群裕度为85％～95％。本发明的锂离子电池具有循环性能好、倍率性能好、安全性能高、低温放电性能好的优点。

abstract: The present application provides a lithium ion battery. The lithium ion battery comprises a positive plate containing a positive active material, a negative plate containing a negative active material and electrolyte. The positive active material includes an inner core and a coating layer. The coating layer is coated on the surface of the inner core and contains boron element. The electrolyte includes a lithium salt, a non-aqueous organic solvent, and an electrolyte additive. The electrolyte additive includes an organic titanium compound. The coating layer of the lithium ion battery anode active material contains boron, the electrolyte contains an organic titanium compound, and the lithium ion battery has good high-temperature cycle performance and high-temperature storage performance under the combined action of the boron and the organic titanium compound. 本申请提供一种锂离子电池。所述锂离子电池包括包含正极活性材料的正极片，包含负极活性材料的负极片以及电解液。所述正极活性材料包括内核以及包覆层。所述包覆层包覆在所述内核的表面且所述包覆层中含有硼元素。所述电解液包括锂盐、非水有机溶剂以及电解液添加剂。所述电解液添加剂包括有机钛化合物。本申请的锂离子电池正极活性材料的包覆层中含有硼元素，且电解液中含有有机钛化合物，在两者的共同作用下锂离子电池具有较好的高温循环性能和高温存储性能。

abstract: The invention discloses a high-energy-density lithium ion battery, which adopts a silicon-based negative electrode and a polymer electrolyte, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a nonaqueous organic solvent, lithium salt, an additive and a polymer dispersed in the electrolyte. The polymer electrolyte can convert the liquid electrolyte in the battery into a gel state with excellent mechanical stability and ion transmission performance after being formed at high temperature. On one hand, the adhesive property of the interface of the silicon-based negative electrode and the diaphragm can be improved, and the interface damage caused by the expansion of the silicon-based negative electrode and the consumption of electrolyte in the circulation process is avoided; on the other hand, the side reaction of the organic solvent on the active surface of the silicon-based negative electrode can be slowed down. The polymer electrolyte can improve the cycle performance of a silicon-based negative electrode lithium ion battery and reduce the thickness expansion rate of the battery in the cycle process. 本发明公开了种高能量密度锂离子电池，该锂离子电池采用硅基负极和聚合物电解液，该聚合物电解液包括非水有机溶剂、锂盐、添加剂及分散在电解液中的聚合物。采用本发明的聚合物电解液可以使电池中的液态电解液经过高温化成后转变成兼具优良力学稳定性和离子传输性能的凝胶态。方面，可以提高硅基负极与隔膜界面的粘结性，避免循环过程中因硅基负极膨胀及电解液消耗引起的界面破坏；另方面，可以减缓有机溶剂在硅基负极的活性表面发生副反应。使用本发明的聚合物电解液可以改善硅基负极锂离子电池的循环性能和降低电池在循环过程中的厚度膨胀率。

The design of welding slag protective glue can prevent metal particles generated in the process of welding the adapter component to the top cover component from falling into the electrode component, and effectively solves the problem of short circuit or self-discharge aggravation of the electrode component caused by the metal particles generated in the welding process in the prior art.

The lithium ion battery of claim 1, wherein the top cap assembly comprises a top cap plate and a pair of terminal posts; the convex hull of the switching component is connected with the pole through welding.

title: 锂离子电池
abstract: 一种锂离子电池包括正极和负极，以及浸泡在电解质溶液中、位于正极和负极之间的纳米多孔或微孔聚合物隔膜。还包括螯合剂，用于在锂离子电池工作期间与过渡金属离子相络合而不影响锂离子穿过隔膜的运动。螯合剂为：溶解在电解质溶液中；作为取代侧基接枝到隔膜的聚合物上；附着于负极和/或正极的粘合剂材料上；涂覆于隔膜的表面；和/或涂覆于负极和/或正极的的表面。螯合剂选自：呈分子形式的离子阱，其选自聚胺、硫醇以及有机酸的碱金属盐；有机酸的碱金属盐官能化的聚合物；含氮官能团官能化的聚合物；两种或更多官能团官能化的聚合物。 A lithium ion battery includes a positive electrode and a negative electrode, and a nanoporous or microporous polymer separator immersed in an electrolyte solution between the positive and negative electrodes. Also included is a chelating agent for complexing with transition metal ions during operation of the lithium ion battery without affecting movement of lithium ions through the separator. The chelating agent is: dissolving in an electrolyte solution; grafted to the polymer of the separator as a pendant substituent group; a binder material attached to the negative electrode and/or the positive electrode; coating the surface of the diaphragm; and/or coated on the surface of the negative electrode and/or the positive electrode. The chelating agent is selected from: an ion trap in molecular form selected from polyamines, thiols, and alkali metal salts of organic acids; an alkali metal salt functionalized polymer of an organic acid; a polymer functionalized with a nitrogen-containing functionality; two or more functionally functionalized polymers.

title: 半导体集成电路
abstract: 本发明提供了一种半导体集成电路，该半导体集成电路能够在输入RAM存储的数据时使用的数据总线位数与输入数据的位数不同时，进行输入数据的数据总线的线选择。该半导体集成电路包括：数据总线D0～D7，其输入数据的K位(K是大于等于2的整数)；选择电路SEL(0)～SEL(13)，其根据由所述数据总线输入N位(N是小于K的整数)数据时设定的信号，选择通过所述数据总线的高位一侧的N条线和低位一侧的N条线中的一方进行输入的数据；以及RAM(随机存取存储器)(1)，其存储被选择电路选择的数据。 A semiconductor integrated circuit is provided which is capable of selecting lines of a data bus to which data is input when the number of bits of input data is different from the number of bits of the data bus with which to input data to be written into a RAM. The semiconductor integrated circuit comprises K-bit data bus lines D0 to D7 (K is an integer 2 or more) to which data is input; selection circuits SEL (0) to SEL (13) for selecting data input through an N number of the data bus lines on the high bit side or through an N number of the data bus lines on the low bit side based on a set signal when N-bit data is input into the data bus lines (N is an integer smaller than K); and a random access memory (RAM) 1 for storing data selected by the selection circuit.

abstract: 第一和第二电压发生器，分别产生施加于第一内部电源线路上的第一内部电源电压和施加于第二内部电源线路上的第二内部电源电压。当第一和第二电压发生器暂停工作时，一短路使第一内部电源电压线和第二内部电源电压线被短接。第一和第二内部电源线路变得浮动，并且储存在各自内部电源线路里的电荷逐渐泄露出去。这里，由于电荷重新分布到两个内部电源线路中，第一和第二内部电源电压当逐渐减少时在值上是相等的。因此，能够防止第一和第二内部电源电压反转，并且能够排除连接第一和第二内部电源线路的内电路发生故障。 First and second voltage generators generate a first internal power supply voltage to be supplied to a first internal power supply line and a second internal power supply voltage to be supplied to a second internal power supply line, respectively. A short circuit shorts the first and second internal power supply lines when operations of both the first and second voltage generators are suspended. The first and second internal power supply lines become floating, and charges stored in the respective internal power supply lines drain out gradually. Here, since the charges are redistributed to both of the internal power supply lines, the first and second internal power supply voltages become equal in value as they drop off. Consequently, the first and second internal power supply voltages can be prevented from inversion, and internal circuits connected to both the first and second internal power supply lines can be precluded from malfunctioning.

A logic dedicated to connection is directly coupled to an internal bus of the micro-computer and is provided between the additional logic for user and the micro-computer. For testing the additional logic for user, a bus/port changeover terminal of the micro-computer and a read/write signal are used to effect readout/writing. Also, a bus inspection register is provided in the logic dedicated to connection. For testing the micro-computer, an output of the inspection register is read out to a bus of the logic dedicated to connection to inspect the bus.

abstract: 本发明的课题是，提供能够容易而且高精度地进行多个输入不同频率的时钟的时钟区之间的相位管理的半导体集成电路。若设A时钟驱动器102、B时钟驱动器103、CMOS缓冲电路119中的时钟的延迟值分别为Ta、Tb、Td，在选择电路114、115、116的端子“0”被选择时，延迟值Ta-Td被存储在寄存电路117中，当切换成端子“1”时，延迟值Ta-Td-Tb被存储在寄存电路118中。因此，借助于设定CMOS缓冲电路119的延迟值，可以设定A时钟驱动器102与B时钟驱动器103的相位差。 Assuming that clocks in an A clock driver (102), a B clock driver (103) and a CMOS buffer circuit (119) have delay values Ta, Tb and Td, respectively, a delay value Ta-Td is stored in a register circuit (117) when terminals '0' of selector circuits (114, 115, 116) are selected, and a delay value Ta-Td-Tb is stored in a register circuit (118) when the terminals '0' are switched to '1'. Thus, determining a delay value at the CMOS buffer circuit (119) allows a phase difference between the A clock driver (102) and B clock driver (103) to be determined.

The arithmetic processing circuit comprises a first processor core performing arithmetic processing and a common unit containing cache memory storing data and programs. At least one of the first processor core and the common unit is divided into a first circuit and a second circuit. The first clock gating circuit supplies or cuts off a clock signal to the first circuit. The first power switch supplies or cuts off a power supply voltage to the first circuit. The second clock gating circuit supplies or cuts off the clock signal to the second circuit. The second power switch supplies or cuts off the power supply voltage to the second circuit. The controller controls the clock gating circuits and the power switches.

abstract: 在半导体集成电路中，虽然组合电路正常地工作，但是，存在着顺序电路由于保持数据的消失而发生误动作的问题。由于构成了控制单元可以使顺序电路所包含的场效应晶体管的阈值电压可变，所以，在动作时可以降低晶体管的阈值电压，向存储保持节点高速地进行数据的写入和读出，在不动作时提高晶体管的阈值电压、减小漏电流，这样，便可使存储保持节点的数据不会破坏和消失，从而可以实现低功耗化。 A semiconductor integrated circuit capable of eliminating a problem of a conventional semiconductor integrated circuit in that although a power saving mode can be applied normally to a combination circuit, it cannot be applied to a sequential circuit because the sequential circuit operates abnormally in the power saving mode, eliminating its holding data, in the conventional semiconductor integrated circuit. The semiconductor integrated circuit has a controller for varying the threshold voltages of field effect transistors included in the sequential circuit so that the controller places the threshold voltages at a low level in an operating mode to speed up the data write and read, and places them at a high level in an idling mode to reduce leakage currents. This makes it possible to prevent the data held in the sequential circuit from being corrupted and eliminated, and to implement a low power consumption. To reduce the leakage current of a circuit which is not operated without destroying holding data of the sequential circuit and to reduce power consumption by providing a control means varying the threshold voltage of a fild effect transistor used in the sequential circuit. title: 半导体集成电路
abstract: 提供防止布线之间的交叉造成的串音并提高电路特性的半导体集成电路。通过在相对于差动放大器(1)的中心线的线对称位置，分别配置各个发射极跟随器电路(22、23)，没有如以往那样的布线之间的交叉区域，可以用一层金属布线(3)来连接电路块内的布线和接地线Vss。由此，可以消除因布线之间的交叉造成的串音问题。 This invention prevents a cross talk caused by intersection of interconnections, and offers a semiconductor integrated circuit with improved circuit characteristics. By disposing a pair of emitter follower circuits symmetrically with respect to a center line of a differential amplifier, an area where the interconnections cross with each other is eliminated and interconnections within a circuit block and a ground wiring can be made with a single metal layer. Herewith cross talk due to the intersection of the interconnections can be resolved.

title: 半导体集成电路
abstract: A semiconductor integrated circuit is provided for attaining a preferred circuit feature by means of realizing a layout disposition in view of a symmetry among each semiconductor element which together compose a circuit block, wherein emitter follower circuits (22, 23) are disposed adjacent to a differential amplifier (21), and are located at a position linearly symmetric to a central line of the differential amplifier (21), respectively. Bipolar transistors (Q24, Q25) that construe the emitter follower circuits (22, 23) are disposed adjacent to bipolar transistors (Q21, Q22) that construe the differential amplifier (21), and are located towards two directions differed in only 90 degree, respectively. As a result, transposition between wirings inputted from the differential amplifier (21) into the emitter follower circuits (22, 23) is diminished, and both the symmetry of the differential amplifier (21) which comprises the emitter follower circuits (22, 23) and the circuit feature are capable of being promoted. 通过实现考虑了构成电路块的各半导体元件的对称性的排布配置，来获得期望的电路特性。将发射极跟随器电路(22、23)配置在差动放大器(21)的附近，并且相对于差动放大器(21)的中心线被分别配置在线对称的位置上。将构成发射极跟随器电路(22、23)的双极晶体管(Q24、Q25)配置在构成差动放大器(21)的双极晶体管(Q21、Q22)的附近，并且被配置在90度不同的方向上。由此，通过没有从差动放大器(21)输入到发射极跟随器电路(22、23)的布线间的交叉，并且可以使布线长度相等，从而可以提高包含发射极跟随器电路(22、23)的差动放大器(1)的对称性，可以实现电路特性的提高。

abstract: 本发明的半导体集成电路是具备产生作为基准的电压的基准电压发生电路、使用该输出电压而动作的功能电路，并将使该输出电压稳定的基准电压稳定电容连接到上述基准电压发生电路的输出端子的半导体集成电路，提供一种能够缩短从待机状态到通常动作状态的恢复时间的半导体集成电路。在待机状态下，功能电路停止动作，但基准电压发生电路避免完全停止，防止基准电压稳定电容放电。由此，在降低模拟电路等功能电路的消耗电力的同时，能够实现从待机状态到通常动作状态的高速恢复。 A semiconductor integrated circuit is provided with a reference voltage generation circuit for generating a voltage to be a reference, a function circuit that is operated using an output voltage of the reference voltage generation circuit, and a reference voltage stabilization capacitor for stabilizing the output voltage, which is connected to an output terminal of the reference voltage generation circuit. During standby, the function circuit stops operating while the reference voltage generation circuit continues operating to prevent discharging of the reference voltage stabilization capacitor, thereby realizing reduction in power consumption of the function circuit such as an analog circuit as well as high-speed recovery from the standby state to the normal operation state.

abstract: 一种半导体集成电路，包括后备存储器(14)、DMA控制部(21)及WDT(监控定时器)(22)。DMA控制部21在CPU(11)处于正常动作WDT(22)接收到计数器复位信号(CR)时，将CPU(11)、RAM(12)及周边电路(13)的各种数据保存到后备存储器(14)中，并且当由WDT(22)检测出程序超限而输出超时信号(TO)时，将保存在后备存储器(14)中的数据分别恢复到CPU(11)、RAM(12)及周边电路(13)中。从而解决了当发生程序超限时对CPU实施复位后会返回初始状态，从初始状态再执行程序会失去中途的数据的问题，实现了即使发生所述程序超限时也可以从该程序的中途开始重新正常动作。 A backup memory, a DMA (direct memory access) controller, and a WDT (watch dog timer) are provided. The DMA controller exercises control so that respective data of the CPU, RAM and peripheral circuit is saved in the backup memory each time the CPU, being under normal operation, supplies a counter reset signal to the WDT, and so that the data that has been saved in the backup memory is restored to the CPU, the RAM and the peripheral circuit, respectively, if the WDT has detected a program runaway and outputted a time-over signal. Therefore, even in a case where a program runaway has occurred in the CPU, normal operation is permitted to be resumed from midway in the program.

abstract: 本发明提供种半导体集成电路。半导体集成电路包括端子、成二极管连接的MOS晶体管、保护二极管电路、电池放电用MOS晶体管、电池电压检测控制电路、以及过电压保护用箝位电路。电池防电涌MOS晶体管分别连接在端子中的相邻的各端子之间。成二极管连接的MOS晶体管分别连接在端子中相邻的各端子之间。从而，在相邻的端子之间施加了浪涌电压的情况下，能保护连接在相邻的端子之间的电路元件使其不受到因浪涌电压导致的静电破坏。 This invention provides a semiconductor integrated circuit having a plurality of terminals, a MOS transistor in diode connection, a protection diode circuit, a MOS transistor for battery discharging, a battery voltage detection control circuit, and an overvoltage protection clamp circuit. Battery surge protection MOS transistors are connected between neighboring terminals. The MOS transistor in diode connection are connected between neighboring terminals. Thus, when surge voltage is applied between neighboring terminals, circuit elements between neighboring terminals can be protected against static damage caused by the surge voltage.

title: 半导体集成电路
abstract: 本申请涉及半导体集成电路。降低半导体集成电路的耗电量，并降低半导体集成电路中的工作延迟。包括在存储电路中的多个时序电路分别包括：晶体管，该晶体管的沟道形成区使用氧化物半导体形成；以及电容器，该电容器的个电极电连接到当所述晶体管截止时成为浮动状态的节点。通过将氧化物半导体用于晶体管的沟道形成区，可以实现断态电流(泄漏电流)极小的晶体管。因此，通过在不向存储电路供应电源电压的期间中使该晶体管截止，可以将该期间中的与电容器的个电极电连接的节点的电位保持为恒定或大致恒定。结果，可以实现上述目的。 This application involves semiconductor integrated circuit.The power consumption of semiconductor integrated circuit is reduced, and reduces the delays in work in semiconductor integrated circuit.The multiple sequence circuits being included in storage circuit include respectively：Transistor, the channel formation region of the transistor are formed using oxide semiconductor；And capacitor, an electrode of the capacitor are electrically connected to when the transistor cutoff as the node of quick condition.By the channel formation region that oxide semiconductor is used for transistor, it is possible to achieve the minimum transistor of off state current (leakage current).Therefore, by making the transistor cutoff in during not supplying supply voltage to storage circuit, the current potential of the node being electrically connected with an electrode of capacitor in this period can be remained constant or constant.As a result, it is possible to achieve above-mentioned purpose.

A semiconductor integrated circuit includes a wiring member formed on a main face of a semiconductor substrate, a fusing member which is connected to the wiring member and has a prescribed thickness, a barrier member which covers the bottom face and side faces of the fusing member, a light absorbing member which covers at least side face portions of the barrier member which covers the fusing member, and an insulating member which embeds the wiring member, the fusing member, the barrier member, and the light absorbing member. The complex permittivity of the light absorbing member has a real number part that is smaller in absolute value than that of the fusing member and an imaginary number part that is larger than that of the fusing member. The thickness of the light absorbing member is preferably 50% or more and 300% or less of the thickness that shows a maximum absorption efficiency for the light used to burn out the fusing member. The light absorbing member is composed of tantalum nitride, tungsten nitride, titanium nitride, or the like.

The semiconductor integrated circuit is provided with a memory, a plurality of logic portions that are capable of being connected to the memory, and a separation portion that connects one of the plurality of logic portions to the memory, while separating the other logic portions from the memory. One required logic portion of the plurality of logic portions is connected to the memory, and the other non-required logic portions are separated from the memory, by the separation portion. The semiconductor integrated circuit can be switched for a system LSI after wafer processing, so this enables a plurality of system LSIs to be manufactured using the same exposure masks, thus improving productivity. Furthermore, defective logic portions can be recovered, thus improving the yield.

abstract: 待机状态下存储器中浪费的功耗被降低了而不降低从存储器读出数据的操作速度。半导体集成电路具有能够进入激活状态或待机状态的存储器，且存储器具有存储单元与之连接的位线和源线的电压发生电路。电压发生电路响应于从激活状态到待机状态转换的指令，使位线的电位和源线的电位彼此相等。电压发生电路响应于从待机状态到激活状态转换的指令，产生位线与源线之间的电位差。在待机状态中，位线的电位和源线的电位彼此相等。因此，在各个存储单元的源与漏之间不出现子阈值泄漏。在激活状态中，源线电位不变化。因此，不降低数据读出操作的速度。 A semiconductor integrated circuit has a memory which can enter active state or standby state, and the memory has voltage generation circuits for bit lines and source lines with which memory cells are connected. The voltage generation circuits make the potential of the bit lines and the potential of the source lines equal to each other in response to an instruction to transition from active state to standby state. The voltage generation circuits produce a potential difference between the bit lines and the source lines in response to an instruction to transition from standby state to active state. In standby state, the potential of the bit lines and that of the source lines are equal to each other. Therefore, sub-threshold leakage does not occur between the source and drain of each memory cell. In active state, the source line potential is not varied.

abstract: 本发明涉及半导体装置和半导体集成电路。提供一种半导体装置，能够迅速稳定用于控制电流源的控制电压。半导体装置包括滤波器电路，该滤波器电路被设置在控制电压产生电路与电流源之间，并且去除控制电压的噪声。所述滤波器电路包括：第一电阻元件，其被设置在控制电压产生电路与输出控制电压的输出节点之间；第一电容元件，其被设置在输出节点与第一电压之间；第二电容元件，其经由第一开关元件来被耦合在输出节点与第一电压之间。当第一开关元件为非导通时，第二电容元件被耦合在第一电压与第二电压之间。当第一开关元件为导通时，第二电容元件通过输出节点来与第一电容元件耦合。 The present invention relates to a semiconductor device and a semiconductor integrated circuit. Provided is a semiconductor device capable of quickly stabilizing a control voltage for controlling a current source. The semiconductor device includes a filter circuit that is provided between the control voltage generation circuit and the current source and removes noise of the control voltage. The filter circuit includes: a first resistance element provided between the control voltage generation circuit and an output node that outputs the control voltage; a first capacitive element provided between the output node and a first voltage; a second capacitive element coupled between the output node and the first voltage via the first switching element. The second capacitive element is coupled between the first voltage and the second voltage when the first switching element is non-conductive. When the first switch element is on, the second capacitive element is coupled to the first capacitive element through the output node.
claims: 1. A semiconductor integrated circuit comprising: a memory module; and a controller for controlling the memory module, wherein the memory module is a single chip, wherein the memory module includes a power supply circuit, wherein the power supply circuit includes: a control voltage generation circuit that outputs a control voltage for controlling the current source; and a filter circuit that is provided between the control voltage generation circuit and the current source and removes noise of the control voltage; wherein the filter circuit comprises: a first resistance element provided between the control voltage generation circuit and an output node that outputs the control voltage, a first capacitive element disposed between the output node and a first voltage, a second capacitive element coupled between the output node and the first voltage in parallel with the first capacitive element, an A first switching element disposed between the second capacitive element and the output node, wherein the first switching element is set to a non-conductive state in a low power consumption mode and set to a conductive state when returning from the low power consumption mode, an Wherein the second capacitive element is coupled between the first voltage and a second voltage in the low power mode and is coupled with the first capacitive element through the output node when returning from the low power mode. 2. The semiconductor integrated circuit according to claim 1, the filter circuit further includes a second switching element that is provided between an internal node between the second capacitance element and the first switching element and the second voltage, and that operates complementarily with the first switching element. 3. The semiconductor integrated circuit according to claim 1, when the first switch element is on, a cutoff frequency of the filter circuit is set based on a resistance component of the first resistance element and capacitance components of the first capacitance element and the second capacitance element. 4. The semiconductor integrated circuit according to claim 2, wherein the control voltage generation circuit comprises: a transistor, a source of the transistor coupled with the first voltage, a second resistive element disposed between the drain of the transistor and the second voltage, an An operational amplifier that outputs the control voltage to a gate of the transistor based on an input of a voltage of a coupling node between the transistor and the second resistance element and a reference voltage. 5. The semiconductor integrated circuit according to claim 4, wherein the operational amplifier is activated in accordance with an activation signal, an Wherein the first switching element and the second switching element receive an input of the activation signal. 6. The semiconductor integrated circuit according to claim 2, each of the first switching element and the second switching element is formed of a MOS transistor. 7. The semiconductor integrated circuit according to claim 1, the controller instructs the memory module to move from the low power consumption mode to a read standby mode.

abstract: The present disclosure relates to a semiconductor device and a semiconductor integrated circuit. The semiconductor device includes: a first reference potential and a second reference potential, the second reference potential being higher than the first reference potential; a first current branch comprising a first NMOS transistor and a first PMOS transistor coupled in sequence between a first reference potential and a second reference potential; and a second current branch comprising a second NMOS transistor and a second PMOS transistor coupled in sequence between the first reference potential and the second reference potential, wherein the second current branch further comprises a third NMOS transistor coupled between a drain of the second NMOS transistor and a drain of the second PMOS transistor, a gate of the third NMOS transistor being coupled to the first bias potential, a potential difference between the first bias potential and the first reference potential remaining fixed. The present disclosure can effectively improve the operating performance of semiconductor devices and semiconductor integrated circuits. 本公开涉及半导体装置以及半导体集成电路。该半导体装置包括：第一参考电位和第二参考电位，第二参考电位高于第一参考电位；第一电流支路，包括依次耦合在第一参考电位与第二参考电位之间的第一NMOS晶体管和第一PMOS晶体管；以及第二电流支路，包括依次耦合在第一参考电位与第二参考电位之间的第二NMOS晶体管和第二PMOS晶体管，其中第二电流支路还包括耦合在第二NMOS晶体管的漏极与第二PMOS晶体管的漏极之间的第三NMOS晶体管，第三NMOS晶体管的栅极被耦合到第一偏置电位，第一偏置电位与第一参考电位之间的电位差保持固定。本公开可以有效改善半导体装置和半导体集成电路的工作性能。

This semiconductor integrated circuit card through setting up the support bar, going up card strip, first spacing strip, the spacing strip of second and lower card strip, has consolidated four limits of the card body, when keeping anti book, the maximize reduces with the area of contact of the card body, also convenient to detach, and PET has resistant book, wear-resisting mechanical properties, PET after the glass reinforcing, the rigidity becomes strong, difficult rupture, has solved the problem that current public transit IC card breaks the damage easily

The utility model provides a semiconductor integrated circuit card, includes card body (1), support strip (2) and goes up card strip (3), its characterized in that: the right-hand member of the card body (1) is pegged graft with the left side of support bar (2), the right-hand member of support bar (2) and the top left side swing joint of support bar (2), the left end swing joint who goes up card strip (3) has first spacing (4), the front threaded connection of first spacing (4) has wrong post (5), the back of first spacing (4) is equipped with spacing (6) of second, the bottom swing joint of spacing (6) of second has lower card strip (7), the right-hand member of lower card strip (7) and the bottom left side swing joint of support bar (2). 2. A semiconductor integrated circuit card according to claim 1, wherein: the front surface of the card body (1) is adhered with a first protective layer (8), and the back surface of the card body (1) is adhered with a second protective layer (9). 4. A semiconductor integrated circuit card according to claim 3, wherein: the second protective layer (9) and the first protective layer (8) are polyethylene film layers. 5. A semiconductor integrated circuit card according to claim 3, wherein: the front surface of the first protective layer (8) is evaporated with a first insulating layer (10), and the first insulating layer (10) is a silicon oxide and titanium dioxide mixed evaporation layer. 6. A semiconductor integrated circuit card according to claim 3, wherein: the back of the second protective layer (9) is evaporated with a second insulating layer (11), and the second insulating layer (11) is a silicon oxide and titanium dioxide mixed evaporation layer. 7. A semiconductor integrated circuit card according to claim 3, wherein: the lower clamping strip (7), the second limiting strip (6), the first limiting strip (4), the upper clamping strip (3) and the support strip (2) are made of glass reinforced PET.

abstract: The invention provides a semiconductor integrated circuit device. A motor speed determining circuit determining a rotation speed of a motor is provided and a processing of generating motor driving waveform is switched in accordance with the rotation speed of the motor. A resolver signal outputted from a resolver 2 is converted to a digital value by an R/D converter 3, and inputted to a computing circuit of resolver value correction 5 via an R/D conversion interface 4. A current value of a motor M is converted to a digital value by an A/D convertor 8. The computing circuit of resolver value correction 5 computes a resolver correction value of the inputted digital signal and calculates positional data from a corrected resolver value. The computing circuit of motor control computes a current instruction value from a motor current value subjected to digital conversion by the A/D converter 8 and a motor current instruction value etc., and a motor waveform output circuit 7 generates a motor driving waveform from the current instruction value and outputs the same to a power module PM. 本发明提供种半导体集成电路器件，包括判断马达旋转速度的马达旋转速度判断电路，根据马达的旋转速度进行马达驱动波形生成处理的切换。从解析器(2)输出的解析信号在R/D变换器(3)被变换为数字值，经由R/D变换接口(4)被输入至解析值修正运算电路(5)。A/D变换器(8)将马达(M)的电流值变换为数字值。解析值修正运算电路(5)运算所输入的数字信号的解析器修正值，根据修正后的解析值计算出位置数据。马达控制运算电路根据计算出的位置数据、A/D变换器(8)进行了数字变换的马达电流值及马达电流指令值等运算电流指令值，马达波形输出电路(7)根据该电流指令值生成马达驱动波形，向动力模块(PM)输出。

Further, a semiconductor integrated circuit device of high speed is provided as a result of the stable clock signal that is generated and distributed. The oscillation circuit is in a semiconductor integrated circuit device having a plurality of oscillators each having an oscillation node, wherein the oscillation nodes of each of the oscillators are connected together by a conductive wiring line that may be a closed loop. The oscillators are synchronized to oscillate at substantially the same frequency. The oscillators are connected to the conductive wiring line at connecting points having substantially the same interval of conductive wiring lengths between the connection points, which leads to synchronizing the oscillators to oscillate with a substantially identical phase. The conductive wiring line can also be formed in the shape of a mesh with the interval of length of the conductive wiring line between the connection points being at least 50 mum. abstract: 本发明提供一种稳压器用半导体集成电路。在具备根据来自外部的控制信号引出输出电容器的电荷的放电电路的稳压器用半导体集成电路中，在放电电路中设有：恒流源电路，其将施加到输入端子的直流电压作为电源电压进行动作，并根据控制信号生成或遮断恒流；基准电压生成电路，其根据来自恒流源电路的恒流生成比较动作的成为基准的电压；电压比较电路，其将输出电压和成为基准的电压进行比较来判定大小；以及电流放大电路，其在输出电压比成为基准的电压高时输出放大了恒流的电流，在控制电路中根据控制信号对控制用晶体管进行控制，在放电电路中放电用晶体管通过由电流放大电路放大后的电流进行动作。 The present invention provides a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit for regulator.In having the semiconductor integrated circuit for regulator according to the discharge circuit for the charge for drawing output capacitor from external control signal, it is equipped in discharge circuit: constant-current source circuit, its DC voltage for being applied to input terminal is acted as supply voltage, and constant current is generated or interdicted according to control signal；Reference voltage generating circuit generates the voltage as benchmark of comparison according to the constant current from constant-current source circuit；Output voltage and the voltage as benchmark are compared to determine size by voltage comparator circuit；And current amplification circuit, its output when output voltage is higher than the voltage for becoming benchmark is exaggerated the electric current of constant current, control is controlled with transistor according to control signal in control circuit, electric discharge is with transistor by being acted by the amplified electric current of current amplification circuit in discharge circuit.

abstract: 一种调节器用半导体集成电路，在切换了输出电压时，输出电压的噪音电平也不大幅变化，具备：根据输出电压所对应的反馈电压和预定的基准电压之间的电位差来控制控制用晶体管使输出电压恒定的控制电路；生成基准电压的基准电压电路；提供基准电压电路的动作电流的电流源电路；以及动作电流变动抑制电路，其进行抑制使基准电压电路的动作电流在输入电压发生变动时也不增减，在该调节器用半导体集成电路中，将上述基准电压电路即带隙基准电压电路构成为可变型基准电压电路，通过改变在基准电压的输出节点和接地点之间连接的串联电阻的一方电阻值而能够变更增益。在基准电压电路和控制电路之间设置还用于去除基准电压中包括的噪音的低通滤波器。 A semiconductor integrated circuit for a regulator, which does not change a noise level of an output voltage significantly even when the output voltage is switched, comprises: a control circuit for controlling the control transistor to make the output voltage constant according to a potential difference between a feedback voltage corresponding to the output voltage and a predetermined reference voltage; a reference voltage circuit for generating a reference voltage; a current source circuit for supplying an operating current of the reference voltage circuit; and an operating current fluctuation suppression circuit for suppressing the operating current of the reference voltage circuit from increasing or decreasing even when the input voltage fluctuates, wherein the bandgap reference voltage circuit, which is the reference voltage circuit, is configured as a variable reference voltage circuit, and the gain can be changed by changing one resistance value of a series resistor connected between an output node of the reference voltage and a ground point. A low-pass filter for removing noise included in the reference voltage is provided between the reference voltage circuit and the control

abstract: 在此公开一种用于提高作为等离子体显示设备这样的显示设备中的驱动能力和功耗的方法。在一个等离子体显示面板显示设备中提供的地址电极驱动电路包括驱动脉冲产生电路，以及多个地址电极驱动部分。在每个地址电极驱动部分中，一个锁存器锁存从另一个锁存器输出的前置脉冲，然后把该脉冲与从该另一个锁存器输出的新脉冲一同输入到异或电路。仅仅当这些脉冲改变时，一个NAND电路输出驱动脉冲/ACL。结果，当位移寄存器输出不改变信号电平的信号时，例如从高电平信号到高电平信号或者从低电平信号到低电平信号，没有输出驱动脉冲/ACL，从而避免无谓的驱动电流消耗。 Disclosed here is a method for improving drivability and reduce power consumption in such a display device as a plasma display device. An address electrode driving circuit provided in a plasma display panel display device includes a driving pulse generation circuit, as well as a plurality of address electrode driving parts. In each of the address electrode driving parts, a latch latches a preceding pulse output from another latch, then inputs the pulse to an exclusive OR circuit together with a new pulse output from the other latch. A NAND-circuit outputs a drive pulse/ACL only when those pulses change. Consequently, when a shift register outputs signals without changing a signal level, for example, from a High signal to a High signal or from a Low signal to a Low signal, no drive pulse/ACL is output, thereby wasteful drive current consumption is prevented.

abstract: 本发明提供了一种半导体集成电路，具有将串行数据转换成并行数据后存储的功能，即使缩短写入/读出的周期也能够稳定动作。该半导体电路包括：串行/并行转换电路(19)，其把与时钟信号一同输入的串行数据转换为并行数据；存储器(21)，其存储被串行/并行转换电路转换的并行数据；以及写入脉冲发生电路(30)，其发生写入脉冲，该写入脉冲用于通过计数时钟信号，设定存储器内的写入时间。 A semiconductor integrated circuit is provided which comprises a serial/parallel conversion circuit for converting serial data which is input together with a clock signal into parallel data; a memory for storing the parallel data converted by the serial/parallel conversion circuit; and a write pulse producing circuit for producing a pulse to be used to set the period of time for writing data into the memory. The semiconductor integrated circuit converts serial data into parallel data, stores the parallel data, and stably operates even when the cycle of data writing/reading is shortened.

abstract: 传统的半导体集成电路器件中，用于防止回流电流的装置具有高导通状态电阻，这使得在正常操作中不可能减少电压损失。本发明半导体集成电路器件具有第一MOS晶体管、设置于第一MOS晶体管与电源端子之间的第二MOS晶体管，以及在正常操作中将第二MOS晶体管的栅极保持在预定电位(最好是地电位)以及当很可能出现回流电流时使第二MOS晶体管截止的装置。在正常操作中，这有助于防止回流电流，同时减少电压损失。 In a conventional semiconductor integrated circuit device, a means for preventing a backflow current has a high on-state resistance, which makes it impossible to reduce the voltage loss in normal operation. A semiconductor integrated circuit device of the invention has a first MOS transistor, a second MOS transistor provided between the first MOS transistor and a power supply terminal, and a means that, in normal operation, keeps the gate of the second MOS transistor at a predetermined potential (preferably the ground potential) and that, when a backflow current is likely, turns the second MOS transistor off. This helps prevent a backflow current while reducing the voltage loss in normal operation.

abstract: 一种开关半导体集成电路具有控制高频信号通过的开关FET，使开关FET在通-断操作间切换。开关半导体集成电路包含使用反相器电路的逻辑控制部分，它根据外部施加的控制信号来产生开关信号，反相器电路使用结型FET，开关FET的栅极经栅极电阻器连接至反相器电路的输出端，此输出端又与耦合部分高频信号的耦合电容器相连。耦合的高频信号被结型FET的栅与漏间的等效二极管整流而叠加在施于开关FET栅极的DC电压上。 A switch semiconductor integrated circuit having a switch FET for controlling passage of a high-frequency signal so that the switch FET is switched between on-operation and off-operation. The switch semiconductor integrated circuit includes a logic control section using of an inverter circuit which generates the switching signal in accordance with a control signal applied from outside, the inverter circuit uses a junction-type FET the gate of the switch FET is connected to an output end of the inverter circuit via a gate resistor, and the output end is connected to a coupling capacitor which couples a part of the high-frequency signal. The coupled high-frequency signal is rectified by an equivalent diode between the gate and drain of the junction-type FET, and is superposed onto a DC voltage applied to the gate of the switch FET.

abstract: In a semiconductor integrated circuit constructed by thin film transistors (TFTs), an invertor circuit or a NAND circuit is formed by arranging a transmission gate circuit, a P-channel type TFT or an N-channel type TFT between a circuit including at least one P-channel type TFT and a circuit including at least one N-channel type TFT. The N-channel type TFT is earthed. Voltage drop produces by the arranged transmission gate circuit or P-channel or N-channel type TFT, so that the drain voltage of the earthed N-channel type TFT is decreased and an electric field near the drain region of the N-channel type TFT is decreased. 在由薄膜晶体管(TFTS)构成的半导体集成电路中，通过在至少包括一个P-沟型TFT的电路和至少包括一个N-沟型TFT的电路之间设置传输门电路，P-沟道型TFT或者N-沟道型TFT构成非门， 或与非门电路。N-沟道型TFT接地。用设置的传输门电路，或P-沟道或N-沟道型TFT产生电压降，因而，减少了接地的N-沟道型TFT的漏电压，并使N-沟道型TFT的漏区附近的电场减弱。

abstract: 本发明涉及种生物基因检测设备，包括试剂滴入口和基因检测器，所述试剂滴入口安装在基因检测器的上端，所述基因检测器的底部设有防滑层，所述基因检测器上对称安装有试管，所述试管上端安装有限位架，所述限位架与试管固定处采用间隙配合方式连接，所述限位架的上端安装有玻璃板，所述基因检测器的右侧安装有检测器盒。本发明通过设置试剂滴入口、基因检测器和防滑层有助于检测剂滴入、安装检测元件并实现基因检测器底部防滑功能，通过设置试管、限位架、玻璃板和检测器盒既有助于多位置存放基因检测液并对检测液防护又有助于安装检测元件。 The present invention relates to a kind of biological gene detection device, including reagent housing instills mouth and genetic test device, the reagent housing instills mouth is arranged on the upper end of genetic test device, the bottom of the genetic test device is provided with skid resistant course, test tube is symmetrically installed with the genetic test device, the test tube upper end is provided with position-limited rack, and the position-limited rack is connected with test tube bearing using gap fiting mode, the upper end of the position-limited rack is provided with glass plate, and detector box is provided with the right side of the genetic test device.The present invention helps to install detecting element by setting reagent housing instills mouth, genetic test device and skid resistant course to contribute to detection agent instillation, install detecting element and realize genetic test device skidproof bottom function by setting test tube, position-limited rack, glass plate and detector box not only to contribute to multiposition to deposit genetic test liquid and protecting detection liquid.

title: 一种生物基因检测设备

titles.text: 一种生物基因检测设备

abstract: The utility model discloses a biological gene check out test set, it relates to biological gene detection area, and its main part sets up to the detection case, be provided with sterilization mechanism in the detection case, sterilization mechanism includes the anion layer, the anion layer sets up in the detection case inner wall, and the anion layer can release the anion, according to the characteristic that the anion particle diameter is little, active high for the anion can be dispersed in each corner of detection case along with the air, and bacterium or impurity contact in anion and the air makes it take place the deactivation or subsides, and then realizes the effect of disinfecting to the detection case, reduces the existence at bacterium dead angle, improves the bactericidal effect. 本实用新型公开了一种生物基因检测设备，其涉及生物基因检测领域，其主体设置为检测箱，所述检测箱内设置有灭菌机构，灭菌机构包括负离子层，所述负离子层设置于检测箱内壁，负离子层可释放出负离子，根据负离子粒径小、活性高的特性，使得负离子可随空气散布于检测箱的各个角落，负离子与空气中的细菌或杂质接触，使其发生灭活或沉降，进而实现对检测箱杀菌的作用，减小细菌死角的存在，提高杀菌效果。
claims: 1. The utility model provides a biological gene check out test set which characterized in that, its main part sets up to detection case (1), be provided with sterilization mechanism in detection case (1), sterilization mechanism includes anion layer (2), anion layer (2) set up in detection case (1) inner wall surface. 2. The biogenic detection apparatus of claim 1, wherein the sterilization mechanism further comprises a microwave sterilization mechanism (3). 3. The biogenic detection apparatus according to claim 1, characterized in that a guard (4) is provided on the detection chamber (1). 4. The biogenic detection apparatus according to claim 2, wherein the microwave sterilization mechanism (3) is provided with a microwave control member (310), the microwave control member (310) comprising a metal propeller blade (311). 5. The biogenic detection device according to claim 4, wherein the microwave adjustment control member (310) is provided with a first angle adjustment control member (312), and the first angle adjustment control member (312) is connected with the metal propeller blade (311) and drives the metal propeller blade (311) to operate. 6. The biogenic detection apparatus of claim 5, wherein the first angular adjustment control (312) comprises a first drive motor (3121). 7. The biogenic detection apparatus according to claim 6, wherein the first angle adjustment control (312) is provided with a first connection member (3122), the first connection member (3122) connecting the first drive motor (3121) and the metal propeller blade (311). 8. The biogenic detection device according to claim 7, wherein the microwave adjustment control member (310) is further provided with a second angle adjustment control member (313), the second angle adjustment control member (313) is connected with the first angle adjustment control member (312), and the second angle adjustment control member (313) and the first angle adjustment control member (312) can simultaneously adjust the movement of the metal screw blade (311). 9. abstract: 一种南寡霉素生物合成基因簇，属于基因技术领域。整个南昌霉素生物合成基因簇共13个基因，具体为：(1)聚酮合酶基因，即nlmA1，nlmA2，nlmA3，nlmA4，nlmA5，nlmA6，nlmA7共7个基因；(2)南寡霉素的修饰基因，即nlmB，nlmOI共2个基因；(3)南寡霉素转座酶基因，即nlmTI，nlmTII共2个基因；(4)南寡霉素的调节基因，即nlmRI；(5)南寡霉素前体物合成基因，即ccrA。本发明所提供的基因及其蛋白质、抗体也可以用来查找和发展可用于医药、工业、农业的化合物或蛋白。 The present invention relates to nanoligomycin biological synthetic gene cluster, belonging to the field of gene technology. The whole nanoligomycin biological synthetic gene cluster has 13 genes, in the concrete they are: (1). polyketone synthase genes, i.e. 7 genes of nlm A1, nlmA2, nlmA3, nlmA4, nlm A5, nlmA6 and nlmA7; (2) modification genes of nanoligomycin, i,e. 2 genes of nlm B and nlmOI; (3) nanoligomycin transposase genes, i.e. 2. genes of nlmTI and nlmTII; (4). regulating gene of nanoligomycin, i.e. nlmRI; and (5) nanoligomycin precursor synthetic gene, i.e. ccrA. The genes and its proteins and antibodies provided by said invention also can be used to seek and develop the compounds and proteins which can be used in medicine, industry and agriculture.

abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of gene detection, in particular to a biotechnological gene detection device, which comprises: the detection device comprises a frame, a groove, a driving assembly and a gene detection module, wherein the groove is formed in the bottom of the frame, the driving assemblies are arranged on the tops of two side plates of the frame, and the gene detection module is connected with the movable end of the driving assembly; the movable placing rack is arranged on the groove and comprises an electric slide rail, an electric slider and a placing plate, the electric slide rail is arranged in the groove, the electric slider is arranged on the electric slide rail, the movable protecting mechanism utilizes the hydraulic cylinder to drive the protecting cover to lift, the internal structure of the detecting device is exposed, the movable placing rack drives the placing plate to slide out through the electric slider, and therefore a worker can place and take a detection sample conveniently and can use the detection sample conveniently. 本实用新型属于基因检测技术领域，具体为一种生物技术基因检测装置，其包括：检测装置、活动放置架和活动防护机构，检测装置包括框架、凹槽、驱动组件和基因检测模块，所述框架底部开设凹槽，所述框架两侧板顶部设置驱动组件，所述基因检测模块与驱动组件活动端连接；活动放置架设置在所述凹槽上，所述活动放置架包括电动滑轨、电动滑块和放置板，所述电动滑轨设置在凹槽内，所述电动滑轨上设置电动滑块，活动防护机构利用液压缸带动防护盖升起，使检测装置内部结构露出，活动放置架通过电动滑块带动放置板滑出，方便工作人员放置和拿取检测样品，便于工作人员使用。
claims: 1. A biotechnological gene detection device characterized by comprising: the detection device (100) comprises a frame (110), a groove (120), a driving component (130) and a gene detection module (140), wherein the groove (120) is formed in the bottom of the frame (110), the driving component (130) is arranged on the tops of two side plates of the frame (110), and the gene detection module (140) is connected with the movable end of the driving component (130); the movable placing rack (200) is arranged on the groove (120), the movable placing rack (200) comprises an electric sliding rail (210), an electric sliding block (220) and a placing plate (230), the electric sliding rail (210) is arranged in the groove (120), the electric sliding block (220) is arranged on the electric sliding rail (210), and the placing plate (230) which is in contact with the bottom of the frame (110) is arranged on the electric sliding block (220); activity protection machanism (300) sets up on frame (110), activity protection machanism (300) include protective cover (310), lug (320) and pneumatic cylinder (330), protective cover (310) and frame (110) gomphosis each other form enclosed construction, protective cover (310) both sides set up lug (320), lug (320) are connected and are fixed at pneumatic cylinder (330) of frame (110) both sides. 2. The biotech gene testing apparatus according to claim 1, wherein the driving assembly (130) uses a screw motor to drive the movable block to move, and the gene testing module (140) is connected to the movable block. 3. The apparatus for detecting biotechnological genes according to claim 1, characterized in that the bottom of the frame (110) is provided with evenly distributed horizontal feet. 4. The apparatus for detecting biotechnological genes according to claim 1, characterized in that the protecting cover (310) is a transparent shell, and a sealing gasket is disposed at the connecting position of the protecting cover (310) and the frame (110). 5. The apparatus for detecting a biotechnological gene according to claim 1 characterized in that a ball is provided between the frame (110) and the placing plate (230), and the ball is embedded in the bottom of the frame (110).

title: 一种生物基因检测设备

abstract: 本实用新型公开了一种生物基因检测设备，包括检测箱，还包括消毒组件和控温组件，所述消毒组件由固定盘、导流板、消毒槽、转轴A、履带、转轴B、电机和消毒盘组成，所述固定盘和电机安装在检测箱顶部，所述固定盘内插接有转轴A，所述转轴A顶部安装有履带，所述电机的动力输出端与转轴B的动力输入端相连，所述履带另一端安装在转轴B上，所述固定盘内安装有导流板，所述固定盘内开设有消毒槽，所述导流板位于消毒槽上方，所述固定盘底部插接有消毒盘。本实用新型通过消毒组件，对检测箱内部喷洒消毒液，进行消毒，避免对下一次检测结果产生影响，通过控温组件，控制检测箱内部的温度，使生物基因检测正常进行。 The utility model discloses a biological gene check out test set, including the detection case, still include disinfection subassembly and accuse temperature subassembly, the disinfection subassembly comprises fixed disk, guide plate, disinfection groove, pivot A, track, pivot B, motor and disinfection dish, the fixed disk and motor are installed at the detection case top, it has pivot A to peg graft in the fixed disk, the track is installed at pivot A top, the power take off end of motor links to each other with pivot B's power input end, the track other end is installed on pivot B, install the guide plate in the fixed disk, the disinfection groove has been seted up in the fixed disk, the guide plate is located disinfection groove top, it has the disinfection dish to peg graft in the fixed disk bottom. The utility model discloses a disinfection subassembly sprays the antiseptic solution to the detection case is inside, disinfects, avoids producing the influence to the testing result next time, through accuse temperature subassembly, controls the inside temperature of detection case, makes biological gene detect normally go on.

The biological gene detection equipment comprises a detection box (1) and is characterized by further comprising a disinfection component (21) and a temperature control component (22), wherein the disinfection component (21) consists of a fixed disc (5), a guide plate (6), a disinfection groove (7), a rotating shaft A (8), a crawler belt (9), a rotating shaft B (10), a motor (11) and a disinfection disc (12), the fixed disc (5) and the motor (11) are installed at the top of the detection box (1), the rotating shaft A (8) is inserted in the fixed disc (5), the crawler belt (9) is installed at the top of the rotating shaft A (8), the power output end of the motor (11) is connected with the power input end of the rotating shaft B (10), the other end of the crawler belt (9) is installed on the rotating shaft B (10), the guide plate (6) is installed in the fixed disc (5), the disinfection groove (7) is formed in the fixed disc (5), the guide plate (6) is positioned above the disinfection groove (7), and the disinfection disc (12) is inserted at the bottom of the fixed disc (5). 2. title: 种生物基因有机肥

titles.text: A kind of biological gene organic fertilizer

abstract: The invention discloses a kind of biological gene organic fertilizer, raw material includes the fermentation of Chinese herbal medicine slag and organic fertilizer that weight ratio is 0.8-1.5:1000, and the organic fertilizer includes animal and plant body remains and food, pericarp, aquatic products, timber processing waste；The Chinese herb residues are the Chinese herbal medicine residue after boiling.Chinese herbal medicine is selected from following raw materials, Radix Astragali, rhizoma polygonati, radix cyathulae, Herba Cistanches, curcuma zedoary, radix cynanchi bungei, Schisandra chinensis, Radix Notoginseng, ginseng, American Ginseng, public English, subprostrate sophora, soft-shelled turtle, tortoiseshell, almond, Radix Salviae Miltiorrhizae, Radix Rehmanniae, Passion Flower, pilose antler, turmeric.Promote plant growth, increases production, increases income, increasing crop taste and nutrition.Organic fertilizer of the present invention can increase crop disease prevention and disease resistance.Prevent breeding from degenerating.People eats the food that the fertilizer production goes out, and can make one health and lengthen one's life. 本发明公开了种生物基因有机肥，原料包括重量比为0.8‑1.5:1000的发酵中草药渣和有机肥，所述有机肥包括动、植物体残骸及食品、果皮、水产品、木材加工废弃物；所述中草药渣为水煮后的中草药残渣。中草药选自下述原料，黄芪、黄精、川牛膝、肉苁蓉、莪术、白首乌、五味子、三七、人参、西洋参、公英、山豆根、鳖、龟板、杏仁、丹参、生地、西蕃莲、鹿茸、姜黄。促进作物生长、增产、增收、增加作物品味和营养。本发明有机肥能增加作物防病和抗病能力。防止良种退化。人食用该肥料生产出的食品，能使人健康益寿。
claims: 1. a kind of Chinese herbal medicine fertilizer, it is characterised in that: 5 kinds in the raw material of following weight parts of the Chinese herbal medicine, Radix Astragali 28-33 Part, 14-16 parts of rhizoma polygonati, 18-21 parts of radix cyathulae, 9-11 parts of Herba Cistanches, 18-22 parts of curcuma zedoary, 14-16 parts of radix cynanchi bungei, Schisandra chinensis 14- 16 parts, 9-11 parts of Radix Notoginseng, 8-11 parts of ginseng, 9-11 parts of American Ginseng, public 18-21 parts of English, 18-21 parts of subprostrate sophora, 14-16 parts of soft-shelled turtle, 8-11 parts of tortoiseshell, 8-11 parts of almond, 18-21 parts of Radix Salviae Miltiorrhizae, 28-31 parts of Radix Rehmanniae, 14-16 parts of Passion Flower, 9-11 parts of pilose antler, turmeric 19-22 parts；Preparation method is to take Chinese herbal medicine, is decocted after bubble, every time one hour it is continuous three times, often boil one hour and pour out medical fluid It adds water and boils, collect medical fluid. 2. a kind of biological gene organic fertilizer, it is characterised in that: raw material includes the fermentation of Chinese herbal medicine that weight ratio is 0.8-1.5:1000 Slag and organic fertilizer, the organic fertilizer include animal and plant body remains and food, pericarp, aquatic products, timber processing waste；It is described Chinese herb residues are the Chinese herbal medicine residue in claim 1 after boiling. 3. the preparation method of biological gene organic fertilizer according to claim 2, it is characterised in that: after Chinese herb residues are fermented, Drying is ground into a powder and is mixed with organic fertilizer. 4. the preparation method of biological gene organic fertilizer according to claim 3, it is characterised in that: fermentation condition is 28-29 DEG C Fermentation 7-10 days.

abstract: The utility model discloses a biological gene detection device, including the water storage box, the concave type frame of top fixedly connected with of water storage box, the fixedly connected with of center department at water storage box top examines test table, the left top fixedly connected with servo motor of concave type frame inner chamber, servo motor's output fixedly connected with threaded rod, the right side of threaded rod is passed through the bearing with the right side of concave type frame inner chamber and is rotated and be connected, and the surface threaded connection of threaded rod has threaded sleeve. The utility model discloses a set up and examine test table, can conveniently have the biological gene sample that needs detected, through setting up electric cylinder and connecting plate, can drive the detector and move down, detect biological gene sample, through setting up suction pump, drinking-water pipe, drain pipe and shower nozzle, can take the water in the water storage box out, then spout to the surface of examining test table, wash the surface of examining test table, through setting up above structure, possess and can carry out abluent advantage to the mesa after detecting. 本实用新型公开了一种生物基因检测装置，包括蓄水箱，蓄水箱的顶部固定连接有凹型框，蓄水箱顶部的中心处固定连接有检测台，凹型框内腔左侧的顶部固定连接有伺服电机，伺服电机的输出端固定连接有螺纹杆，螺纹杆的右侧与凹型框内腔的右侧通过轴承转动连接，螺纹杆的外表面螺纹连接有螺纹套筒。本实用新型通过设置检测台，可以方便存在需要检测的生物基因样本，通过设置电动气缸和连接板，可以带动检测仪向下移动，对生物基因样本进行检测，通过设置抽泵、抽水管、排水管和喷头，可以将蓄水箱内的水抽出，然后喷向检测台的表面，对检测台的表面进行清洗，通过设置以上结构，具备在检测之后可

title: 一种生物基因检测装置

applicants: CHONGQING INT TRAVEL HEALTH CARE CENTER
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of gene detection, and discloses a biological gene detection device, which comprises a box body with a box door, wherein a controller is fixedly arranged on the right side of the box body, the top of the box body is provided with an opening, a pipettor support is arranged at the opening, a plurality of through holes are arranged on the pipettor support, a sliding cover is arranged on each through hole and is used for placing the pipettor, a plurality of gene detectors corresponding to the through holes are arranged inside the box body, the upper surface of each gene detector is a V-shaped concave surface, each concave surface is provided with a gene probe, a baffle is arranged around the concave surface, a temperature sensor is arranged on each baffle, a heating plate and a fan are arranged on the inner side wall of the box body, an ultraviolet disinfection lamp is arranged on the upper, the heating plate and the fan are both electrically connected with the output end of the controller. abstract: 本发明公开了种基因工程生物指示剂，用于种或多种灭菌效力的生物监测，其通过基因工程技术手段将外源基因导入指示微生物中，而外源基因包括启动子，报告基因和选择性标记基因。其中选择性标记基因位于诱导型启动子上游，报告基因位于诱导型启动子下游。在无诱导物存在下，选择性标记基因表达，报告基因无表达，用于筛选转染成功的菌株。经过灭菌因子暴露后，指示微生物同诱导物相接触，报告基因表达。本发明无需特异性酶底物，可自发荧光，同时也具有较高的性噪比，荧光信号强，易检测，灵敏度高等多种优点。 The invention discloses a genetic engineering biological indicator used for biological monitoring of one or more sterilization effects. According to the genetic engineering biological indicator, foreign genes, including promoters, reporter genes and selectable maker genes, are guided into indicator microorganisms by means of genetic engineering. The selectable maker genes are positioned on the upstream of the inducible promoters, and the reporter genes are positioned on the downstream of the inducible promoters. In the absence of inducers, the selectable maker genes are expressed, the reporter genes are not expressed, and accordingly, successfully-transfected strains are screened. After exposure by sterilization factors, the indicator microorganisms contact with the inducers, and the reporter genes are expressed. Autofluorescence of the genetic engineering biological indicator can be achieved without specific enzyme substrates, and the genetic engineering biological indicator has the advantages of high signal-to-noise ratio, strong fluorescence signal, easiness in detection, high sensitivity and the like.

title: 一种微生物基因检测装置

titles.text: 一种微生物基因检测装置

abstract: The utility model discloses a microbial gene detection device, which belongs to the technical field of microbial detection and comprises an outer shell, a filtrate inner cylinder, a sealing cover, a sliding buckling mechanism, a filtrate mechanism and an elastic support piece, wherein the sealing cover is used for sealing the same end of the outer shell and the filtrate inner cylinder, the sliding buckling mechanism is arranged between the outer shell and the side wall of the filtrate inner cylinder and used for calibrating the liquid taking amount of the filtrate inner cylinder, the filtrate mechanism is used for separating supernatant liquid generated by centrifugation in the outer shell, and the elastic support piece is arranged between the outer shell and the filtrate mechanism and used for limiting and supporting the filtrate inner cylinder. The utility model provides a microbial gene detection device, which can quantitatively filter supernatant generated by centrifugation in an outer shell as required by sliding a filtrate inner cylinder arranged in the outer shell, and has the functions of quantitatively removing liquid and preventing secondary pollution. 本实用新型公开了一种微生物基因检测装置，属于微生物检测技术领域，本实用新型包括外壳体、滤液内筒、封盖、滑动扣合机构、滤液机构和弹性支撑件，其中封盖用于将外壳体和滤液内筒的同一端密封，滑动扣合机构，设置在所述外壳体与所述滤液内筒侧壁之间，用于标定滤液内筒的取液量，滤液机构用于分离外壳体内离心产生的上清液，弹性支撑件设置在所述外壳体与所述滤液机构之间，用于对所述滤液内筒限位和支撑。本实用新型提供了一种微生物基因检测装置，通过滑动设置在外壳体中的滤液内筒，可将外壳体中离心产生的上清液按需求定量滤除，具有定量去液、防止二次污染的功能。

title: 一种生物基因提取仪器
