abstract: The utility model discloses a biological gene extraction instrument, which relates to the technical field of biological gene extraction instruments and comprises a shell, wherein a gear mechanism is fixedly connected inside the shell and comprises a first motor, an output shaft of the first motor is fixedly connected with a first rotating shaft through a coupler, one end of the first rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a first gear, the outer wall of the first gear is in meshed connection with a second gear, one end of the second gear is fixedly connected with a threaded rod, and the outer wall of the threaded rod is in meshed connection with a fixed block. According to the utility model, through the first motor, the first rotating shaft, the first gear, the second gear, the threaded rod and the fixed block, the automatic extraction of samples can be realized, and the plurality of extraction heads can simultaneously extract samples in the plurality of test tubes, so that the problem of low manual extraction efficiency is solved, and the practicability of the device is improved. 本实用新型公开了一种生物基因提取仪器，涉及生物基因提取仪器技术领域，包括外壳，所述外壳的内部固定连接有齿轮机构，所述齿轮机构包括第一电机，所述第一电机的输出轴通过联轴器固定连接有第一转轴，所述第一转轴的一端固定连接有第一齿轮，所述第一齿轮的外壁啮合连接有第二齿轮，所述第二齿轮的一端固定连接有螺纹杆，所述螺纹杆的外壁啮合连接有固定块。本实用新型通过设置的第一电机、第一转轴、第一齿轮、第二齿轮、螺纹杆、固定块，可以实现自动对样品进行提取，且设置的多个提取头，可以同时对多个试管中样品进行提取，解决了人工提取效率慢的问题，使得装置的实用性得到了提升。
claims: 1. A biological gene extraction apparatus comprising a housing (1), characterized in that: the novel electric motor is characterized in that the gear mechanism (2) is fixedly connected to the inside of the shell (1), the gear mechanism (2) comprises a first motor (201), an output shaft of the first motor (201) is fixedly connected with a first rotating shaft (202) through a coupler, one end of the first rotating shaft (202) is fixedly connected with a first gear (203), a second gear (204) is connected with the outer wall of the first gear (203) in a meshed mode, a threaded rod (205) is fixedly connected to one end of the second gear (204), and a fixed block (206) is connected with the outer wall of the threaded rod (205) in a meshed mode. 2. abstract: 本发明公开了一种生物基因检测设备，其涉及生物基因检测领域，其主体设置为检测箱，所述检测箱内设置有灭菌机构，灭菌机构包括负离子层，所述负离子层设置于检测箱内壁，负离子层可释放出负离子，根据负离子粒径小、活性高的特性，使得负离子可随空气散布于检测箱的各个角落，负离子与空气中的细菌或杂质接触，使其发生灭活或沉降，进而实现对检测箱杀菌的作用，减小细菌死角的存在，提高杀菌效果。 The invention discloses a biological gene detection device, which relates to the field of biological gene detection, and the main body of the biological gene detection device is a detection box, a sterilization mechanism is arranged in the detection box, the sterilization mechanism comprises an anion layer, the anion layer is arranged on the inner wall of the detection box, the anion layer can release anions, according to the characteristics of small anion particle size and high activity, the anions can be scattered at each corner of the detection box along with the air, and the anions are contacted with bacteria or impurities in the air to be inactivated or settled, so that the sterilization effect on the detection box is realized, the existence of bacteria dead corners is reduced, and the sterilization effect is improved.

abstract: 本发明提供了可利霉素生物合成基因簇，含有的基因至少包括聚酮合酶基因5个(orf10‑14)，与糖基合成相关的orf有16个(9、16‑22、24、26、28、29、33‑35、41)，与糖基转移相关的6个orf(7、8、30‑32、40)中的至少5个，此外，还含有外源引入的碳霉糖4”‑O‑异戊酰转移酶基因orf44。通过基因簇序列信息和结构分析，可以进一步对其产生菌进行遗传操作，获得新型、更有效的抗生素，如通过基因操作来改变其PKS合成模块式结构、进行内酯环后修饰的改变、糖基因的置换或修饰，创造新的大环内酯类抗生素，也可以通过对抗性基因或调节基因的遗传操作，提高抗生素的产量。所提供的基因及其蛋白质、抗体，也可用以筛选和发展可用于医药、工业、农业的化合物或蛋白。 The invention provides a colimycin biosynthesis gene cluster, which contains at least 5 genes (orf10-14) of polyketide synthase, 16 orfs (9, 16-22, 24, 26, 28, 29, 33-35 and 41) related to glycosyl synthesis, at least 5 of 6 orfs (7, 8, 30-32 and 40) related to glycosyl transfer, and also contains exogenously introduced mycaminose 4' -O-isovaleryltransferase gene orf 44. Through gene cluster sequence information and structural analysis, genetic manipulation can be further carried out on the producing strain to obtain novel and more effective antibiotics, for example, the PKS synthetic modular structure is changed through genetic manipulation, the change of lactone ring post-modification and the replacement or modification of sugar genes are carried out, new macrolide antibiotics are created, and the yield of the antibiotics can also be improved through the genetic manipulation on resistance genes or regulatory genes. The provided gene, protein and antibody thereof can also be used for screening and developing compounds or proteins which can be used for medicine, industry and agriculture.

abstract: 本发明涉及对将包含微生物丛的样本进行DNA测序得到的碱基序列进行聚类，以下将上述碱基序列称为样本序列，上述聚类包括以下步骤：对于样本序列，将具有100％的同源性的碱基序列彼此归为一组，由此生成初级OTU(Operational Taxonomic Unit，操作分类单元)；进一步对样本序列进行聚类，由此生成次级OUT，该次级OUT由规定的质心的序列和相对于该规定的质心的序列具有规定的阈值以上的同源性的样本序列构成。其中，规定的阈值小于100％。在各次级OTU所包含的初级OTU中，将序列数最多的初级OTU的序列作为该次级OTU的代表序列，将代表序列与数据库进行比对，由此进行该次级OTU的系统推测。 The present application relates to a method for clustering a base sequence obtained by DNA sequencing a sample containing a microbiota, the base sequence being hereinafter referred to as a sample sequence, the method comprising the steps of: grouping base sequences having 100% homology to each other for the sample sequences, thereby generating primary OTUs (Operational Taxonomic Unit, operation classification unit); the sample sequences are further clustered to generate a secondary OUT composed of a sequence of a predetermined centroid and a sample sequence having homology of a predetermined threshold or more with respect to the sequence of the predetermined centroid. Wherein the prescribed threshold is less than 100%. Among primary OTUs included in each secondary OTU, the sequence of the primary OTU having the largest number of sequences is used as a representative sequence of the secondary OTU, and the representative sequence is aligned with a database, thereby performing system estimation of the secondary OTU.

一种用于生物基因工程的基因检测设备

applicants: XIAN ZHONGKEZHIPU MEDICAL INSPECTION CO LTD
abstract: 本实用新型公开了一种用于生物基因工程的基因检测设备，包括壳体、检测单元、拿取单元、壳盖和防护板；壳体：所述壳盖与壳体的顶端相配合，壳体前侧面底端的通槽铰接有防护板，壳体内部的底端设有拿取单元，壳盖的底端设有拆卸单元；检测单元：包含第一直线电机、第二直线电机、电动伸缩杆、检测仪、检测探针，第二直线电机有两个且分别设在壳体内部的左右两侧，第一直线电机两端的定子分别与两个第二直线电机动子座的内侧面连接，第一直线电机动子座的底端设有电动伸缩杆，电动伸缩杆的底端安装有检测仪，检测仪的底端设有检测探针；该用于生物基因工程的基因检测设备，使用简单，拆卸方便，实用性强，检测效果好。 The utility model discloses a gene detection device for biological gene engineering, which comprises a shell, a detection unit, a taking unit, a shell cover and a protection plate; a housing: the shell cover is matched with the top end of the shell, a protection plate is hinged to a through groove at the bottom end of the front side face of the shell, a taking unit is arranged at the bottom end inside the shell, and a disassembling unit is arranged at the bottom end of the shell cover; a detection unit: the detection device comprises a first linear motor, a second linear motor, electric telescopic rods, a detector and detection probes, wherein the second linear motor is provided with two stators which are respectively arranged at the left side and the right side inside a shell; the gene detection equipment for the biological gene engineering is simple to use, convenient to disassemble, high in practicability and good in detection effect.

title: 一种藻类生物基因用基因检测系统

titles.text: Gene detection system for algae organism genes
一种藻类生物基因用基因检测系统

applicants: GUANGDONG YUEHAI WATER TESTING TECH CO LTD
abstract: 本发明公开了一种藻类生物基因用基因检测系统，涉及基因检测技术领域，一种藻类生物基因用基因检测系统，包括样本采集模块、特征提取模块、扩增模块、测序模块、分析模块以及报告模块，本系统通过样本采集模块的高效采样方法和特征提取模块的精细数据处理，确保了环境数据的准确性和全面性，其次，扩增模块和测序模块的高效基因处理和测序技术，提高了基因数据的灵敏度和准确性。最后，分析模块的整合计算方法和报告模块的可视化展示，使得基因异常检测更加精准和及时，便于用户做出科学的干预决，通过整合不同数据集，系统能够更全面地评估藻类生物的基因状态，相比单一数据集分析，能够提供更准确和全面的评估结果。 The invention discloses a gene detection system for algae biological genes, which relates to the technical field of gene detection, and comprises a sample acquisition module, a feature extraction module, an amplification module, a sequencing module, an analysis module and a reporting module, the system ensures the accuracy and comprehensiveness of the environmental data through the efficient sampling method of the sample acquisition module and the fine data processing of the feature extraction module, and secondly, the sensitivity and the accuracy of the gene data are improved through the efficient gene processing and sequencing technology of the amplification module and the sequencing module. Finally, the integrated calculation method of the analysis module and the visual display of the reporting module enable the gene abnormality detection to be more accurate and timely, facilitate the user to make scientific intervention decisions, enable the system to evaluate the gene states of the algae more comprehensively by integrating different data sets, and provide more accurate and comprehensive evaluation results compared with single data set analysis.

The kit comprises a microorganism wall breaking unit and a microorganism cracking unit; the microbial wall breaking unit comprises a wall breaking reagent and a wall breaking enzyme composition reagent; the microbial lysis unit comprises a protease reagent and a lysis reagent. The invention also provides a method for extracting the microbial genome based on the magnetic bead method microbial genome extraction kit. title: 通过全基因组测序检测微生物基因组中的基因组序列

titles.text: Detection of genomic sequences in microbial genomes by whole genome sequencing
通过全基因组测序检测微生物基因组中的基因组序列

abstract: 一种以读数形式检测微生物的测序的基因组中预定位置处的靶基因组序列的方法。所述方法包括计算靶基因组序列邻域位置中基因组的局部测序深度，所述计算包括以下步骤：a)在读数中检测来自所述微生物的至少一个参考基因组的一组数字基因组序列，b)生成第三组数字基因组序列，其包含读数和属于邻域的第二组数字基因组序列，c)计数第三组数字基因组序列中每个数字基因组序列的拷贝数，以及d)计算局部测序深度等于计数的拷贝数的最大值。 A method of detecting a target genomic sequence at a predetermined location in a sequenced genome of a microorganism in the form of a read. The method comprises calculating a local sequencing depth of a genome in a target genome sequence neighborhood position, the calculating comprising the steps of: a) detecting in the reads a set of digital genomic sequences from at least one reference genome of the microorganism, b) generating a third set of digital genomic sequences comprising the reads and a second set of digital genomic sequences belonging to a neighborhood, c) counting the copy number of each digital genomic sequence in the third set of digital genomic sequences, and d) calculating a local sequencing depth equal to the maximum of the counted copy numbers.

abstract: The invention discloses a biosynthesis gene cluster of alkaloid cyanamide and application thereof. titles.text: Biological cell storage box for biological gene engineering
一种用于生物基因工程用生物细胞储存箱

abstract: 本实用新型公开了一种用于生物基因工程用生物细胞储存箱，包括箱体，所述箱体的内壁固定连接有安置座，所述安置座的顶部开设有试管槽，所述试管槽的内壁固定连接有海绵垫，所述试管槽的内壁固定连接有连接板，所述连接板的外壁固定连接有伸缩杆，所述伸缩杆的一端固定连接有固定板。通过设置的复位弹簧、弹力布等结构，使试管的保护效果更好，将试管放到试管槽中的海绵垫的内侧，使固定板和夹持块对试管进行限位，然后移动弹力布，使弹力布的一端穿过定位条的下方并进行翻转，使两个魔术贴贴合，对试管进行固定，试管在复位弹簧和弹力布弹力的作用下进行固定，有效防止移动装置时试管产生的晃动，起到更好的保护试管的效果。 The utility model discloses a be used for biological cell bin for biological genetic engineering, the power distribution box comprises a box body, the inner wall fixedly connected with seat of box, the test-tube groove has been seted up at the top of seat of placing, the inner wall fixedly connected with foam-rubber cushion in test-tube groove, the inner wall fixedly connected with connecting plate in test-tube groove, the outer wall fixedly connected with telescopic link of connecting plate, the one end fixedly connected with fixed plate of telescopic link. Through the reset spring who sets up, elasticity cloth isotructure, make the protection effect of test tube better, place the inboard of the foam-rubber cushion in the test tube groove with the test tube, it is spacing to make fixed plate and grip block carry out the test tube, then remove elasticity cloth, the below that the one end that makes elasticity cloth passed the location strip is carried out and is overturn, make two magic subsides laminating, fix the test tube, the test tube is fixed under reset spring and elasticity cloth effect of elasticity, what the test tube produced when effectively preventing the mobile device rocks, p
claims: 1. A biological cell storage box for biological gene engineering, which comprises a box body (1), and is characterized in that: the inner wall of the box body (1) is fixedly connected with a placing seat (2), the top of the placing seat (2) is provided with a test tube groove (3), the inner wall of the test tube groove (3) is fixedly connected with a sponge cushion (4), the inner wall of the test tube groove (3) is fixedly connected with a connecting plate (5), the outer wall of the connecting plate (5) is fixedly connected with a telescopic rod (6), one end of the telescopic rod (6) is fixedly connected with a fixing plate (7), a reset spring (8) is fixedly connected between the fixing plate (7) and the outer wall of the connecting plate (5) and positioned at the outer side of the telescopic rod (6), the outer wall of the fixing plate (7) is fixedly connected with a clamping block (9), the outer wall of the placing seat (2) is fixedly connected with an elastic cloth (10) and a positioning strip (11), the elastic cloth (10) is wound at the outer side of the positioning strip (11), and the outer wall of the elastic cloth (10) is fixedly connected with two magic tapes, and the outer walls of the two magic tapes are bonded. 2. The storage tank for biological cells for use in biogenetic engineering as claimed in claim 1, wherein: the inner wall of arrangement seat (2) rotates and is connected with transparent label board (12), finger groove (13) have been seted up to the outer wall of arrangement seat (2) and the one side that is located transparent label board (12), outer wall fixedly connected with locating piece (14) of transparent label board (12), the inner wall of arrangement seat (2) and the relative fixedly connected with rubber block (15) in top that is located locating piece (14), the outer wall laminating of rubber block (15) and locating piece (14), label groove (16) have been seted up to the outer wall of transparent label board (12). 3. The storage tank for biological cells for use in biogenetic engineering as claimed in claim 1, wherein: the inside of test tube groove (3) is provided with test tube (17), the outer wall laminating with the outer wall of foam-rubber cushion (4), fixed plate (7), grip block (9) and elasticity cloth (10) respectively of test tube (17). 4. The storage tank for biological cells for use in biogenetic engineering as claimed in claim 1, wherein: the liquid nitrogen gas extraction device is characterized in that a liquid nitrogen inlet pipe (18) and an exhaust pipe (19) are fixedly connected to the inner wall of one side of the box body (1), electromagnetic valves (20) are fixedly connected to the outer walls of the liquid nitrogen inlet pipe (18) and the exhaust pipe (19), and a control panel (21) is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the box body (1). 5. The storage tank for biological cells for use in biogenetic engineering as claimed in claim 1, wherein: the outer wall of the box body (1) is hinged to a box cover (22), and the top of the box cover (22) is rotatably connected with a lifting handle (23). 6. The storage tank for biological cells for use in biogenetic engineering as claimed in claim 5, wherein: the outer wall fixedly connected with latch fitting (24) of case lid (22), case lid (22) pass through latch fitting (24) and box (1) fixed connection. 7. The storage tank for biological cells for use in biogenetic engineering as claimed in claim 1, wherein: the outer wall of the bottom of the box body (1) is fixedly connected with a damping base (25) relatively.
